verses.text: duṣkaraṃ niṣpratidvandvaṃ cikīrṣan karma vānaraḥ । samudagraśirogrīvo gavāṃ patir ivābabhau ॥2॥
mumoca ca śilāḥ śailo viśālāḥ samanaḥśilāḥ । madhyamenārciṣā juṣṭo dhūmarājīr ivānalaḥ ॥16॥
iti vidyādharā vācaḥ śrutvā teṣāṃ tapasvinām । tam aprameyaṃ dadṛśuḥ parvate vānararṣabham ॥31॥
vānarān vānaraśreṣṭha idaṃ vacanam abravīt । yathā rāghavanirmuktaḥ śaraḥ śvasanavikramaḥ ॥39॥
gacchet tadvad gamiṣyāmi laṅkāṃ rāvaṇapālitām । na hi drakṣyāmi yadi tāṃ laṅkāyāṃ janakātmajām ॥40॥
anenaiva hi vegena gamiṣyāmi surālayam । yadi vā tridive sītāṃ na drakṣyāmi kṛtaśramaḥ ॥41॥
baddhvā rākṣasarājānam ānayiṣyāmi rāvaṇam । sarvathā kṛtakāryo 'ham eṣyāmi saha sītayā ॥42॥
ānayiṣyāmi vā laṅkāṃ samutpāṭya sarāvaṇām । evam uktvā tu hanumān vānarān vānarottamaḥ ॥43॥
utpapātātha vegena vegavān avicārayan । suparṇam iva cātmānaṃ mene sa kapikuñjaraḥ ॥44॥
mērumandarasaṃkāśānudgatān sumahārṇave । atyakrāman mahāvegas taraṅgān gaṇayann iva ॥72॥
tasya vēgasamudghūṣṭaṃ jalaṃ sajaladaṃ tadā । ambarasthaṃ vibabhrāje śāradābhram ivātatam ॥73॥
timinakrajhaṣāḥ kūrmā dṛśyante vivṛtās tadā । vastrāpakarṣaṇeneva śarīrāṇi śarīriṇām ॥74॥
śuśubhe sa mahātejā mahākāyo mahākapiḥ । vāyumārge nirālambe pakṣavāniva parvataḥ ॥78॥
yenāsau yāti balavān vēgena kapikuñjaraḥ । tena mārgeṇa sahasā droṇīkṛta ivārṇavaḥ ॥79॥
āpāte pakṣisaṃghānāṃ pakṣirāja iva vrajan । hanumān meghajālāni prakarṣan māruto yathā ॥80॥
pāṇḍurāruṇavarṇāni nīlamāñjiṣṭhakāni ca । kapinākṛṣyamāṇāni mahābhrāṇi cakāśire ॥81॥
praviśann abhrajālāni niṣpataṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ । pracchannaś ca prakāśaś ca candramā iva lakṣyate ॥82॥
sa mahātmā muhūrtena parvataḥ salilāvṛtaḥ । darśayām āsa śṛṅgāṇi sāgareṇa niyojitaḥ ॥103॥
mānuṣaṃ dharayan rūpam ātmanaḥ śikhare sthitaḥ । duṣkaraṃ kṛtavān karma tvam idaṃ vānarottama ॥111॥
nipatya mama śṛṅgeṣu sukhaṃ viśramya gamyatām । rāghāvasya kule jātair udadhiḥ parivardhitaḥ ॥112॥
sa tvāṃ rāmahite yuktaṃ pratyarcayati sāgaraḥ । kṛte ca pratikartavyam eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥113॥
so 'yaṃ tat pratikārārthī tvattaḥ sammānam arhati । tvannimittam anenāhaṃ bahumānāt pracoditaḥ ॥114॥
yojanānāṃ śataṃ cāpi kapir eṣa kham āplutaḥ । tava sānuṣu viśrāntaḥ śeṣaṃ prakramatām iti ॥115॥
vara eṣa purā datto mama dhātreti satvarā । vyādāya vaktraṃ vipulaṃ sthitā sā māruteḥ puraḥ ॥151॥
taṃ prayāntaṃ samudvīkṣya surasā vākyam abravīt । balaṃ jijñāsamānā vai nāgamātā hanūmataḥ ॥157॥
niviśya vadanaṃ me 'dya gantavyaṃ vānarottama । vara eṣa purā datto mama dhātreti satvarā ॥158॥
vyādāya vipulaṃ vaktraṃ sthitā sā māruteḥ puraḥ । evam uktaḥ surasayā kruddho vānarapuṃgavaḥ ॥159॥
abravīt kuru vai vaktraṃ yena māṃ viṣahiṣyasi । ity uktvā surasāṃ kruddho daśayojanam āyatām ॥160॥
hanumān meghajālāni prākarṣan māruto yathā । kālāgurusavarṇāni raktapītasitāni ca ॥181॥
kapinā kṛṣyamāṇāni mahābhrāṇi cakāśire । praviśann abhrajālāni niṣpataṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥182॥
prāvṛṣīndur ivābhāti niṣpatan praviśaṃs tadā । plavamānaḥ sarvatra hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ॥183॥
bheje 'mbaraṃ nirālambaṃ pakṣayuta ivādrirāṭ । plavamānaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃhikā nāma rākṣasī ॥184॥
manasā cintayām āsa pravṛddhā kāmarūpiṇī । adya dīrghasya kālasya bhaviṣyāmy aham āśitā ॥185॥
idaṃ mama mahasattvaṃ cirasya vaśam āgatam । iti saṃcintya manasā chāyām asya samakṣipat ॥186॥
chāyāyāṃ gṛhyamāṇāyāṃ cintayām āsa vānaraḥ । samākṣipto 'smi sahasā paṅgūkṛtaparākramaḥ ॥187॥
pratilomena vātena mahānaur iva sāgare । tiryag ūrdhvam adhaś caiva vīkṣamāṇas tadā kapiḥ ॥188॥
dadarśa sa mahāsattvam utthitaṃ lavaṇāmbhasi । tad dṛṣṭvā cintayām āsa mārutir vikṛtānanām ॥189॥
ghanarājīva garjantī vānaraṃ samabhidravat । sa dadarśa tatas tasyā vikṛtaṃ sumahan mukham ॥193॥
kāyamātraṃ ca medhāvī marmāṇi ca mahākapiḥ । sa tasyā vivṛte vaktre vajrasaṃhananaḥ kapiḥ ॥194॥
saṃkṣipya muhur ātmānaṃ nipapāta mahākapiḥ । āsye tasyā nimajjantaṃ dadṛśuḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ॥195॥
grasyamānaṃ yathā candraṃ pūrṇaṃ parvaṇi rāhuṇā । tatas tasya nakhais tīkṣṇair marmāṇy utkṛtya vānaraḥ ॥196॥
utpapātātha vegena manaḥsampātavikramaḥ । tāṃ tu diṣṭyā ca dhṛtya ca dākṣiṇyena nipātya saḥ ॥197॥
kapipravīro vegena vavṛdhe punar ātmavān । hṛtahṛtsā hanumatā papāta vidhurāmbhasi । svayambhuvaiva hanumān sṛṣṭas tasyā nipātane ॥198॥
tadrūpamatisaṃkṣipya hanumān prakṛtau sthitaḥ । trīn kramāniva vikramya balivīryaharo hariḥ ॥209॥
tatas tu samprāpya samudratīraṃ । samīkṣya laṅkāṃ girivaryamūrdhni । kapis tu tasmin nipapāta parvate । vidhūya rūpaṃ vyathayanmṛgadvijān ॥212॥
pāṇḍurābhiḥ pratolībhir uccābhir abhisaṃvṛtām । aṭṭālakaśatākīrṇāṃ patākādhvajaśālinīm ॥17॥
vapraprākārajaghanāṃ vipulāmbuvanāmbarām । śataghnīśūlakēśāntām aṭṭālakāvataṃsakām ॥21॥
manaseva kṛtāṃ laṅkāṃ nirmitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā । dvāram uttaram āsādya cintayām āsa vānaraḥ ॥22॥
kailāsanilayaprakhyām ālikhantīm ivāmbaram । dhrīyamānām ivākāśam ucchritair bhavanottamaiḥ ॥23॥
sūrye cāstaṃ gate rātrau dehaṃ saṃkṣipya mārutiḥ । vṛṣadaṃśakamātro 'tha babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ ॥49॥
atha sā hariśārdūlaṃ praviśantam mahākapim । nagarī svena rūpeṇa dadarśa pavanātmajam ॥20॥
sā taṃ harivaraṃ dṛṣṭvā laṅkā rāvaṇapālitā । svayamevotthitā tatra vikṛtānanadarśanā ॥21॥
purastāt tasya vīrasya vāyusūnor atiṣṭhata । muñcamānā mahānādam abravīt pavanātmajam ॥22॥
kas tvaṃ kena ca kāryeṇa iha prāpto vanālaya । kathayasveha yat tattvaṃ yāvat prāṇā dharanti te ॥23॥
na śakyaṃ khalv iyaṃ laṅkā praveṣṭuṃ vānara tvayā । rakṣitā rāvaṇabalair abhiguptā samantataḥ ॥24॥
atha tām abravīd vīro hanuman agrataḥ sthitām । kathayiṣyāmi tat tattvaṃ yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchase ॥25॥
kā tvaṃ virūpanayanā puradvāre 'vatiṣṭhase । kimarthaṃ cāpi māṃ krodhān nirbhartsayasi dāruṇe ॥26॥
hanumadvacanaṃ śrutvā laṅkā sā kāmarūpiṇī । uvāca vacanaṃ kruddhā paruṣaṃ pavanātmajam ॥27॥
ahaṃ rākṣasarājasya rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ । ājñāpratīkṣā durdharṣā rakṣāmi nagarīm imām ॥28॥
na śakyaṃ mām avajñāya praveṣṭuṃ nagarīṃ imām । adya prāṇaiḥ parityaktaḥ svapsyase nihato mayā ॥29॥
ahaṃ hi nagarī laṅkā svayameva plavaṃgama । sarvataḥ parirakṣāmi atas te kathitaṃ mayā ॥30॥
laṅkāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ । yatnavān sa hariśreṣṭhaḥ sthitaḥ śaila ivāparaḥ ॥31॥
sa tāṃ strīrūpavikṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarapuṃgavaḥ । ābabhāṣe 'tha medhāvī sattvavān plavagarṣabhaḥ ॥32॥
drakṣyāmi nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ sāṭṭaprākāratoraṇām । ity artham iha samprāptaḥ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ॥33॥
vanānyupavanānīha laṅkāyāḥ kānanāni ca । sarvato gṛhamukhyāni draṣṭum āgamanaṃ hi me ॥34॥
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā laṅkā sā kāmarūpiṇī । bhūya eva punar vākyaṃ babhāṣe paruṣākṣaram ॥35॥
mām anirjitya durbuddhe rākṣaseśvarapālitāṃ । na śakyam adya te draṣṭuṃ purīyaṃ vānarādhama ॥36॥
tataḥ sa hariśārdūlas tām uvāca niśācarīm । dṛṣṭvā purīm imāṃ bhadre punar yāsye yathāgatam ॥37॥
tataḥ kṛtvā mahānādaṃ sā vai laṅkā bhayākaram । talena vānaraśreṣṭhaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegitā ॥38॥
tataḥ sa hariśārdūlo laṅkayā tāḍito bhṛśam । nanāda sumahānādaṃ vīryavān mārutātmajaḥ ॥39॥
tataḥ saṃvartayāmāsa vāmahastasya so 'ṅgulīḥ । muṣṭinābhijaghānaināṃ hanumān krodhamūrchitaḥ ॥40॥
strī ceti manyamānena nātikrodhaḥ svayaṃ kṛtaḥ । sā tu tena prahāreṇa vihvalāṅgī niśācarī । papāta sahasā bhūmau vikṛtānanadarśanā ॥41॥
tatas tu hanumān vīras tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vinipātitām । kṛpāṃ cakāra tejasvī manyamānaḥ striyaṃ ca tām ॥42॥
tato vai bhṛśam udvignā laṅkā sā gadgadākṣaram । uvācāgarvitaṃ vākyaṃ hanūmantaṃ plavaṃgamam ॥43॥
prasīda sumahābāho trāyasva harisattama । samaye saumya tiṣṭhanti sattvavanto mahābalāḥ ॥44॥
ahaṃ tu nagarī laṅkā svayameva plavaṃgama । nirjitāhaṃ tvayā vīra vikrameṇa mahābala ॥45॥
idaṃ ca tathyaṃ śṛṇu vai bruvantyā me harīśvara । svayaṃ svayaṃbhuvā dattaṃ varadānaṃ yathā mama ॥46॥
yadā tvāṃ vānaraḥ kaścid vikramād vaśamānayet । tadā tvayā hi vijñeyaṃ rakṣasāṃ bhayam āgatam ॥47॥
sa hi me samayaḥ saumya prāpto 'dya tava darśanāt । svayaṃbhūvihitaḥ satyo na tasyāsti vyatikramaḥ ॥48॥
sītānimittaṃ rājñas tu rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ । rakṣasāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ vināśaḥ samupāgataḥ ॥49॥
tat praviśya hariśreṣṭha purīṃ rāvaṇapālitām । vidhatsva sarvakāryāṇi yāni yānīha vāñchasi ॥50॥
praviśya śāpopahatāṃ harīśvara । purīṃ śubhāṃ rākṣasamukhyapālitām । yadṛcchayā tvaṃ janakātmajāṃ satīṃ । vimārga sarvatra gato yathāsukham ॥51॥
sa nirjitya purīṃ laṅkāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tāṅ kāmarūpiṇīm । vikrameṇa mahātejā hanumān kapisattamaḥ ॥1॥
advāreṇa mahāvīryaḥ prākāram avapupluve । niśi laṅkāṃ mahāsattvo viveśa kapikuñjaraḥ ॥2॥
praviśya nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ kapirājahitaṃkaraḥ । cakre ’tha pādaṃ savyaṃ ca śatrūṇāṃ sa tu mūrdhani ॥3॥
tatas tu tāṃ purīṃ laṅkāṃ ramyām abhiyayau kapiḥ । hasitotkṛṣṭaninadais tūryaghoṣapuraskṛtaiḥ ॥5॥
vajrāṅkuśanikāśaiś ca vajrajālavibhūṣitaiḥ । gṛhamedhaiḥ purī ramyā babhāse dyaur ivāmbudaiḥ ॥6॥
vardhamānagṛhaiś cāpi sarvataḥ suvibhāṣitaiḥ । tāṃ citramālyābharaṇāṃ kapirājahitaṃkaraḥ ॥8॥
rāghavārthe carañ śrīmān dadarśa ca nananda ca । bhavanād bhavanaṃ gacchan dadarśa kapikuñjaraḥ ॥9॥
vividhākṛtirūpāṇi bhavanāni tatas tataḥ । śuśrāva ruciraṃ gītaṃ tristhānasvarabhūṣitam ॥10॥
strīṇāṃ madanaviddhānāṃ divi cāpsarasām iva । śuśrāva kāñcīninādaṃ nūpurāṇāṃ ca niḥsvanam ॥11॥
sopānaninadāṃś cāpi bhavaneṣu mahātmanām । āsphoṭitaninādāṃś ca kṣveḍitāṃś ca tatas tataḥ ॥12॥
śuśrāva japatāṃ tatra mantrān rakṣogṛheṣu vai । svādhyāyaniratāṃś caiva yātudhānān dadarśa saḥ ॥13॥
rāvaṇastavasaṃyuktān garjato rākṣasān api । rājamārgaṃ samāvṛtya sthitaṃ rakṣogaṇaṃ mahat ॥14॥
dadarśa madhyame gulme rākṣasasya carān bahūn । dīkṣitāñ jaṭilān muṇḍān gojināmbaravāsasaḥ ॥15॥
darbhamuṣṭipraharaṇān agnikuṇḍāyudhāṃs tathā । kūṭamudgarapāṇīṃś ca daṇḍāyudhadharān api ॥16॥
ekākṣānekakarṇāṃś ca lambodarapayodharān । karālān bhugnavaktrāṃś ca vikaṭān vāmanāṃs tathā ॥17॥
dhanvinaḥ khaḍginaś caiva śataghnīmusalāyudhān । parighottamahastāṃś ca vicitrakavacojjvalān ॥18॥
virūpān bahurūpāṃś ca surūpāṃś ca suvarcasaḥ । dhvajīnaḥ patākinaścaiva dadarśa vividhāyudhān ॥20॥
tīkṣṇaśūladharāṃś caiva vajriṇaś ca mahābalān । śatasāhasram avyagram ārakṣaṃ madhyamaṃ kapiḥ ॥23॥
rakṣodhipatinirdiṣṭaṃ dadarśāntaḥpurāgrataḥ । sa tadā tad gṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāhāṭakatoraṇam ॥24॥
rākṣasendrasya vikhyātam adrimūrdhni pratiṣṭhitam । puṇḍarīkāvataṃsābhiḥ parikhābhiḥ samāvṛtam ॥25॥
prākārāvṛtam atyantaṃ dadarśa sa mahākapiḥ । triviṣṭapanibhaṃ divyaṃ divyanādavināditam ॥26॥
vājihreṣitasaṃghuṣṭaṃ nāditaṃ bhūṣaṇais tathā । rathair yānair vimānaiś ca tathā hayagajaiḥ śubhaiḥ ॥27॥
vāraṇaiś ca caturdantaiḥ śvetābhranicayopamaiḥ । bhūṣitai ruciradvāraṃ mattaiś ca mṛgapakṣibhiḥ ॥28॥
sahemajāmbūnadacakravālaṃ । mahārhamuktāmaṇibhūṣitāntam । parārdhyakālāgurucandanārhaṃ । sa rāvaṇāntaḥpuram āviveśa ॥30॥
vinaṣṭaśītāmbutuṣārapaṅko । mahāgrahagrāhavinaṣṭapaṅkaḥ । prakāśalakṣmyāśrayanirmalāṅko । rarāja candro bhagavān śaśāṅkaḥ ॥6॥
śilātalaṃ prāpya yathā mṛgendro । mahāraṇaṃ prāpya yathā gajendraḥ । rājyaṃ samāsādya yathā narēndras । tathā prakāśo virarāja candraḥ ॥7॥
dadarśa kāntāś ca samālabhantyas । tathāparās tatra punaḥ svapantyaḥ । surūpavaktrāś ca tathā hasantyaḥ । kruddhāḥ parāś cāpi viniḥsvasantyaḥ ॥13॥
bherīmṛdaṅgābhirutaṃ śaṅkhaghoṣavināditam । nityārcitaṃ parvasutaṃ pūjitaṃ rākṣasaiḥ sadā ॥12॥
samudram iva gambhīraṃ samudrasamaniḥsvanam । mahātmāno mahad veśma mahāratnaparicchadam ॥13॥
mahāratnasamākīrṇaṃ dadarśa sa mahākapiḥ । virājamānaṃ vapuṣā gajāśvarathasaṃkulam ॥14॥
laṅkābharaṇam ity eva so 'manyata mahākapiḥ । cacāra hanumaṃs tatra rāvaṇasya samīpataḥ ॥15॥
vajradaṃṣṭrasya ca tathā pupluve sa mahākapiḥ । śukasya ca mahāvegaḥ sāraṇasya ca dhīmataḥ ॥20॥
tathā cendrajito veśma jagāma hariyūthapaḥ । jambumāleḥ sumāleś ca jagāma harisattamaḥ ॥21॥
raśmiketoś ca bhavanaṃ sūryaśatros tathaiva ca । vajrakāyasya ca tathā pupluve sa mahākapiḥ ॥22॥
rākṣasāṃś ca mahākāyān nānāpraharaṇodyatān । raktāñ śvetān sitāṃś cāpi harīṃś cāpi mahājavān ॥31॥
kulīnān rūpasampannān gajān paragajārujān । sikṣitān gajaśikṣāyām airāvatasamān yudhi ॥32॥
nihantṝn parasainyānāṃ gṛhe tasmin dadarśa saḥ । kṣarataś ca yathā meghān sravataś ca yathā girīn ॥33॥
meghastanitanirghoṣān durdharṣān samare paraiḥ । sahasraṃ vāhinīs tatra jāmbūnadapariṣkṛtāḥ ॥34॥
śibikā vividhākārāḥ sa kapir mārutātmajaḥ । latāgṛhāṇi citrāṇi citraśālāgṛhāṇi ca ॥36॥
krīḍāgṛhāṇi cānyāni dāruparvatakāni ca । kāmasya gṛhakaṃ ramyaṃ divāgṛhakam eva ca ॥37॥
sa tasya madhye bhavanasya saṃsthito । mahadvimānam maṇiratnacitritam । prataptajāmbūnadajālakṛtrimaṃ । dadarśa dhīmān pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ ॥1॥
tadaprameyapratikārakṛtrimaṃ । kṛtaṃ svayaṃ sādhviti viśvakarmaṇā । divaṃ gataṃ vāyupathe pratiṣṭhitaṃ । vyarājatādityapathasya lakṣma tat ॥2॥
na tatra kiṃcinna kṛtaṃ prayatnato । na tatra kiṃcinna mahargharatnavat । na te viśeṣā niyatāḥ sureṣvapi । na tatra kiṃcinna mahāviśeṣavat ॥3॥
tapassamādhānaparākramārjitaṃ । manassamādhānavicāracāriṇam । anekasaṃsthānaviṣeṣanirmitaṃ । tatas tatas tulyaviśeṣanirmitam ॥4॥
manaḥ samādhāya tu śīghragāminaṃ । durāsadaṃ mārutatulyagāminam । mahātmanāṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ mahārddhināṃ । yaśasvinām agryamudām ivālayam ॥5॥
viśeṣam ālambya viśeṣasaṃsthitaṃ । vicitrakūṭam bahukūṭamaṇḍitam । mano’abhirāmaṃ śaradindunirmalaṃ । vicitrakūṭaṃ śikharaṃ girer yathā ॥6॥
vahanti yat kuṇḍalaśobhitānanā । mahāśanā vyomacarā niśācarāḥ । vivṛttavidhvastaviśālalocanā । mahājavā bhūtagaṇāḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥7॥
vasantapuṣpotkaracārudarśanaṃ । vasantamāsād api cārudarśanam । sa puṣpakam tatra vimānamuttamaṃ । dadarśa tad vānaravīrasattamaḥ ॥8॥
uttamaṃ rākṣasāvāsaṃ hanuman avalokayan । āsasādātha lakṣmīvān rākṣasendraniveśanam ॥4॥
vidrumeṇa vicitreṇa maṇibhiśca mahāghanaiḥ । nistulābhiśca muktābhis talenābhivirājitam ॥17॥
candanena ca raktena tapanīyanibhena ca । supuṇyagandhinā yuktam ādityataruṇōpamam ॥18॥
vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ divyam āruroha mahākapiḥ । tatrasthaḥ sarvato gandhaṃ pānabhakṣyānnasambhavam ॥19॥
divyaṃ sammūrchitaṃ jighran rūpavantam ivānilam । sa gandhas taṃ mahāsattvaṃ bandhur bandhum ivottamam ॥20॥
ita ehīty uvāceva tatra yatra sa rāvaṇaḥ । tatas tāṃ prasthitaḥ śālāṃ dadarśa mahatīṃ śubhām ॥21॥
rāvaṇasya manaḥkāntāṃ kāntām iva varastriyam । maṇisopānavikṛtāṃ hemajālavirājitām ॥22॥
sphāṭikair āvṛtatalāṃ dantāntaritarūpikām । muktāvajrapravālaiś ca rūpyacāmīkarair api ॥23॥
vibhūṣitāṃ maṇistambhaiḥ subahustambhabhūṣitām । samair ṛjubhir atyuccaiḥ samantāt suvibhūṣitaiḥ ॥24॥
stambhaiḥ pakṣair ivātyuccair divaṃ samprasthitām iva । mahatyā kuthayāstrīṇaṃ pṛthivīlakṣaṇāṅkayā ॥25॥
pṛthivīm iva vistīrṇāṃ sarāṣṭragṛhaśālinīm । nāditāṃ mattavihagair divyagandhādhivāsitām ॥26॥
parārdhyāstaraṇopetāṃ rakṣo'dhipaniṣevitām । dhūmrām agurudhūpena vimalāṃ haṃsapāṇḍurām ॥27॥
patrapuṣpopahāreṇa kalmāṣīm iva suprabhām । manaso modajananīṃ varṇasyāpi prasādhinīm ॥28॥
tāṃ śokanāśinīṃ divyāṃ śriyaḥ saṃjananīm iva । indriyāṇīndriyārthais tu pañca pañcabhir uttamaiḥ ॥29॥
yuddhakāmena tāḥ sarvā rāvaṇena hṛtāḥ striyaḥ । samadā madanenaiva mohitāḥ kāścid āgatāḥ ॥69॥
dāntakāñcanacitrāṅgair vaiḍūryaiś ca varāsanaiḥ । mahārhāstaraṇopetair upapannaṃ mahādhanaiḥ ॥2॥
jātarūpaparikṣiptaṃ citrabhānoḥ samaprabham । aśokamālāvitataṃ dadarśa paramāsanam ॥4॥
aṅgahārais tathaivānyā komalair nṛtyaśālinī । vinyastaśubhasarvāṅgī prasuptā varavarṇinī ॥36॥
vipañcīṃ parigṛhyānyā niyatā nṛtyaśālinī । nidrāvaśam anuprāptā sahakānteva bhāminī ॥41॥
tarkayām āsa sīteti rūpayauvanasampadā । harṣeṇa mahatā yukto nananda hariyūthapaḥ ॥53॥
anyeyam iti niścitya bhūyas tatra cacāra saḥ । pānabhūmau hariśreṣṭhaḥ sītāsaṃdarśanotukaḥ ॥4॥
deśakālābhiyuktena yuktavākyābhidhāyinā । ratādhikena saṃyuktāṃ dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ ॥8॥
anyatrāpi varastrīṇāṃ rūpasaṃlāpaśāyinām । sahasraṃ yuvatīnāṃ tu prasuptam sa dadarśa ha ॥9॥
lehyān uccāvacān peyān bhojyāny uccāvacāni ca । tathāmlalavaṇottaṃsair vividhai rāgakhāṇḍavaiḥ ॥18॥
mahānūpurakeyūrair apaviddhair mahādhanaiḥ । pānabhājanavikṣiptaiḥ phalaiś ca vividhair api ॥19॥
kṛtapuṣpopahārā bhūr adhikaṃ puṣyati śriyam । tatra tatra ca vinyastaiḥ suśliṣṭaśayanāsanaiḥ ॥20॥
pānabhūmir vinā vahniṃ pradīptevopalakṣyate । bahuprakārair vividhair varasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaiḥ ॥21॥
māṃsaiḥ kuśalasaṃyuktaiḥ pānabhūmigataiḥ pṛthak । divyāḥ prasannā vividhāḥ surāḥ kṛtasurā api ॥22॥
śarkarāsavamādhvīkāḥ puṣpāsavaphalāsavāḥ । vāsacūrṇaiś ca vividhair mṛṣṭās tais taiḥ pṛthakpṛthak ॥23॥
jāmbūnadamayaiś cānyaiḥ karakair abhisaṃvṛtā । rājateṣu ca kumbheṣu jāmbūnadamayeṣu ca ॥25॥
tāni tāni ca pūrṇāni bhājanāni mahākapiḥ । kva cid ardhāvaśeṣāṇi kva cit pītāny aśeṣataḥ ॥27॥
kva cin naiva prapītāni pānāni sa dadarśa ha । kva cid bhakṣyāṃś ca vividhān kva cit pānāni bhāgaśaḥ ॥28॥
pravavau surabhir gandho vimāne puṣpake tadā । śyāmāvadātās tatrānyāḥ kāś cit kṛṣṇā varāṅganāḥ ॥34॥
kāś cit kāñcanavarṇāṅgyaḥ pramadā rākṣasālaye । tāsāṃ nidrāvaśatvāc ca madanena vimūrchitam ॥35॥
sa bhūyaḥ sarvataḥ śrīmān mārutir yatnam āśritaḥ । āpānabhūmim utsṛjya tāṃ vicetuṃ pracakrame ॥48॥
kānanaiḥ kṛtrimaiś cāpi sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtām । ye ke cit pādapās tatra puṣpopagaphalopagāḥ ॥35॥
sacchatrāḥ savitardīkāḥ sarve sauvarṇavedikāḥ । latāpratānair bahubhiḥ parṇaiś ca bahubhir vṛtām ॥36॥
kāñcanīṃ śiṃśupām ekāṃ dadarśa sa mahākapiḥ । vṛtām hemamayībhis tu vedikābhiḥ samantataḥ ॥37॥
viniṣpatadbhiḥ śataśaś citraiḥ puṣpāvataṃsakaiḥ । samūlapuṣparacitair aśokaiḥ śokanāśanaiḥ ॥7॥
puṣpabhārātibhāraiś ca spṛśadbhir iva medinīm । karṇikāraiḥ kusumitaiḥ kiṃśukaiś ca supuṣpitaiḥ ॥8॥
sa deśaḥ prabhayā teṣāṃ pradīpta iva sarvataḥ । puṃnāgāḥ saptaparṇāś ca campakoddālakās tathā ॥9॥
vivṛddhamūlā bahavaḥ śobhante sma supuṣpitāḥ । śātakumbhanibhāḥ ke cit ke cid agniśikhaprabhāḥ ॥10॥
nīlāñjananibhāḥ ke cit tatrāśokāḥ sahasraśaḥ । nandanaṃ vividhodyānaṃ citraṃ caitrarathaṃ yathā ॥11॥
ativṛttam ivācintyaṃ divyaṃ ramyaśriyāyutam । dvitīyam iva cākāśaṃ puṣpajyotirgaṇāyutam ॥12॥
puṣparatnaśataiś citraṃ pañcamaṃ sāgaraṃ yathā । sarvartupuṣpair nicitaṃ pādapair madhugandhibhiḥ ॥13॥
nānāninādair udyānaṃ ramyaṃ mṛgagaṇadvijaiḥ । anekagandhapravahaṃ puṇyagandhaṃ manoramam ॥14॥
śailendram iva gandhāḍhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ gandhamādanam । aśokavanikāyāṃ tu tasyāṃ vānarapuṃgavaḥ ॥15॥
sa dadarśāvidūrasthaṃ caityaprāsādam ūrjitam । madhye stambhasahasreṇa sthitaṃ kailāsapāṇḍuram ॥16॥
pravālakṛtasopānaṃ taptakāñcanavedikam । muṣṇantam iva cakṣūṃṣi dyotamānam iva śriyā ॥17॥
nirmalaṃ prāṃśubhāvatvād ullikhantam ivāmbaram । tato malinasaṃvītāṃ rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtām ॥18॥
upavāsakṛśāṃ dīnāṃ niḥśvasāntīṃ punaḥ punaḥ । dadarśa śuklapakṣādau candrarekhām ivāmalām ॥19॥
sukhārhāṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptāṃ vyasanānām akovidām । tāṃ vilokya viśālākṣīm adhikaṃ malināṃ kṛśām ॥26॥
tarkayām āsa sīteti kāraṇair upapādibhiḥ । hriyamāṇā tadā tena rakṣasā kāmarūpiṇā ॥27॥
yathārūpā hi dṛṣṭā sā tathārūpeyam aṅganā । pūrṇacandrānanāṃ subhrūṃ cāruvṛttapayodharām ॥28॥
kurvantīṃ prabhayā devīṃ sarvā vitimirā diśaḥ । tāṃ nīlakeśīṃ (nīlakaṇṭhīṃ) bimboṣṭhīṃ sumadhyāṃ supratiṣṭhitām ॥29॥
sītāṃ padmapalāśākṣīṃ manmathasya ratiṃ yathā । iṣṭāṃ sarvasya jagataḥ pūrṇacandraprabhām iva ॥30॥
bhūmau sutanum āsīnāṃ niyatām iva tāpasīm । niḥśvāsabahulāṃ bhīruṃ bhujagendravadhūm iva ॥31॥
śokajālena mahatā vitatena na rājatīm । saṃsaktāṃ dhūmajālena śikhām iva vibhāvasoḥ ॥32॥
tāṃ smṛtīm iva saṃdigdhām ṛddhiṃ nipatitām iva । vihatām iva ca śraddhām āśāṃ pratihatām iva ॥33॥
sopasargāṃ yathā siddhiṃ buddhiṃ sakaluṣām iva । abhūtenāpavādena kīrtiṃ nipatitām iva ॥34॥
rāmoparodhavyathitāṃ rakṣogaṇanipīḍitām । abalāṃ mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ vīkṣamāṇāṃ tatas tataḥ ॥35॥
bāṣpāmbuparipūrṇena kṛṣṇavakrākṣipakṣmaṇā । vadanenāprasannena niḥśvasantīṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥36॥
duṣkaraṃ kṛtavān rāmo hīno yad anayā prabhuḥ । dhārayatyātmano dehaṃ na śokenāvasīdati ॥53॥
malinena tu vastreṇa parikliṣṭena bhāminīm । saṃvṛtāṃ mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ dadarśa hanumān kapiḥ ॥26॥
tāṃ devīṃ dīnavadanām adīnāṃ bhartṛtejasā । rakṣitāṃ svena śīlena sītām asitalocanām ॥27॥
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā hanumān sītāṃ mṛgaśāvanibhekṣaṇām । mṛgakanyām iva trastāṃ vīkṣamāṇāṃ samantataḥ ॥28॥
dahantīm iva niḥśvāsair vṛkṣān pallavadhāriṇaḥ । saṃghātam iva śokānāṃ duḥkhasyormim ivotthitām ॥29॥
tāṃ kṣāmāṃ suvibhaktāṅgīṃ vinābharaṇaśobhinīm । praharṣam atulaṃ lebhe mārutiḥ prekṣya maithilīm ॥30॥
harṣajāni ca so 'śrūṇi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā madirekṣaṇām । mumoca hanumāṃs tatra namaś cakre ca rāghavam ॥31॥
vyāviddhahārakeyūrāḥ samāmṛditavarṇakāḥ । samāgalitakeśāntāḥ sasvedavadanās tathā ॥16॥
ghūrṇantyo madaśeṣeṇa nidrayā ca śubhānanāḥ । svedakliṣṭāṅgakusumāḥ sumālyākulamūrdhajāḥ ॥17॥
prayāntaṃ nairṛtapatiṃ nāryo madiralocanāḥ । bahumānācca kāmācca priyā bhāryās tam anvayuḥ ॥18॥
sa ca kāmaparādhīnaḥ patis tāsāṃ mahābalaḥ । sītāsaktamanā mando mandāñcitagatir babhau ॥19॥
malamaṇḍanadigdhāṅgīṃ maṇḍanārhām amaṇḍanām । mṛṇālī paṅkadigdheva vibhāti na vibhāti ca ॥6॥
paurṇamāsīm iva niśām tamograstendumaṇḍalām । padminīm iva vidhvastāṃ hataśūrāṃ camūm iva ॥13॥
prabhām iva tamodhvastām upakṣīṇām ivāpagām । vedīm iva parāmṛṣṭāṃ śāntām agniśikhām iva ॥14॥
sādhu paśyāmi te rūpaṃ suyuktaṃ pratikarmaṇā । pratikarmābhisaṃyuktā dākṣiṇyena varānane ॥22॥
bhuṅkṣva bhogān yathākāmaṃ piba bhīru ramasva ca । yatheṣṭaṃ ca prayaccha tvaṃ pṛthivīṃ vā dhanāni ca ॥23॥
kulaṃ samprāptayā puṇyaṃ kule mahati jātayā । evam uktvā tu vaidehī rāvaṇaṃ taṃ yaśasvinī ॥5॥
rāvaṇaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā bhūyo vacanam abravīt । nāham aupayikī bhāryā parabhāryā satī tava ॥6॥
sādhu dharmam avekṣasva sādhu sādhuvrataṃ cara । yathā tava tathānyeṣāṃ rakṣyā dārā niśācara ॥7॥
vaco mithyā praṇītātmā pathyam uktaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ । rakṣasānāmabhāvāya tvaṃ vā na pratipadyase ॥10॥
viditaḥ sa hi dharmajñaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ । tena maitrī bhavatu te yadi jīvitum iccasi ॥20॥
prasādayasva tvaṃ cainaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalam । māṃ cāsmai prayato bhūtvā niryātayitum arhasi ॥21॥
evam hi te bhavet svasti sampradāya raghūttame । anyathā tvam hi kurvaṇaḥ parāṃ prāpsyasi cāpadam ॥22॥
tābhyāṃ sa paripūrṇābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ । śuśubhe 'calasaṃkāśaḥ śṛṅgābhyāmiva mandaraḥ ॥27॥
sa kalpavṛkṣapratimo vasanta iva mūrtimān । śmaśānacaityapratimo bhūṣito 'api bhayamkaraḥ ॥29॥
anāsikāṃ siṃhamukhīṃ gomukhīṃ sūkarīmukhīm । yathā madvaśagā sītā kṣipraṃ bhavati jānakī ॥36॥
tathā kuruta rākṣasyaḥ sarvāḥ kṣipraṃ sametya ca । pratilomānulomaiś ca sāmadānādibhedanaiḥ ॥37॥
āvarjayata vaidehīṃ daṇḍasyodyamanena ca । iti pratisamādiśya rākṣasendraḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥38॥
kāmamanyuparītātmā jānakīṃ prati garjata । upagamya tataḥ kṣipraṃ rākṣasī dhānyamālinī ॥39॥
pariṣvajya daśagrīvam idaṃ vacanam abravīt । mayā krīḍa maharaja sītayā kiṃ tavānayā ॥40॥
vivarṇayā kṛpaṇayā mānuṣyā rākṣaseśvara । nūnamasyāṃ mahārāja na devā bhogasattamān ॥41॥
icchantīṃ kāmayānasya prītir bhavati śobhanā । evamuktas tu rākṣasyā samutkṣiptas tato balī । prahasan meghasamkāśo rākṣasaḥ sa nyavartata ॥43॥
mayoktaṃ cārusarvāṅgi vākyam kiṃ nānumanyase | । tato harijaṭā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt || ॥9॥
vivartya nayane kopān mārjārasadṛśekṣaṇā | । yena devāstrāyastriṃśad devarājaśca nirjatāḥ || ॥10॥
trailōkyavasubhoktāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasēśvaram । bhartāram upasaṅgamya viharasva yathāsukham ॥4॥
dīno vā rājyahīno vā yo me bhartā sa me guruḥ । taṃ nityaṃ anuraktāsmi yatha sūryaṃ suvarcalā ॥9॥
yathā śacī mahābhāgā śakraṃ samupatiṣṭhati । arundhatī vasiṣṭhaṃ ca rohiṇī śaśinaṃ yathā ॥10॥
lopāmudrā yathāgastyaṃ sukanyā cyavanaṃ yathā । sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca kapilaṃ śrīmatī yathā ॥11॥
saudāsaṃ madayantīva keśinī sagaraṃ yathā । naiṣadhaṃ damayantīva bhaimī patimanuvratā ॥12॥
na ca naḥ kuruṣe vākyaṃ hitaṃ kālapuraskṛtam । ānītāsi samudrasya pāram anyair durāsadam ॥30॥
rāvaṇāntaḥpure ghore praviṣṭā cāsi maithili । rāvaṇasya gṛhe ruddhā asmābhis tu surakṣitā ॥31॥
na tvāṃ śaktaḥ paritrātum api sākṣāt puraṃdaraḥ । kuruṣva hitavādinyā vacanaṃ mama maithili ॥32॥
alam aśruprapātena tyaja śokam anarthakam । bhaja prītiṃ praharṣaṃ ca tyajantī nityadainyatām ॥33॥
sīte rākṣasarājena parikrīḍa yathāsukham । jānīmahe yathā bhīru strīṇāṃ yauvanam adhruvam ॥34॥
yāvan na te vyatikrāmet tāvat sukham avāpnuhi । udyānāni ca ramyāṇi parvatopavanāni ca ॥35॥
saha rākṣasarājena cara tvaṃ madirekṣaṇe । strīsahasrāṇi te devi vaśe sthāsyanti sundari ॥36॥
rāvaṇaṃ bhaja bhartāraṃ bhartāraṃ sarvarakṣasām । utpāṭya vā te hṛdayaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi maithili ॥37॥
yadi me vyāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ na yathāvat kariṣyasi । tataś caṇḍodarī nāma rākṣasī krūradarśanā ॥38॥
bhrāmayantī mahacchūlam idaṃ vacanam abravīt । imāṃ hariṇaśāvākṣīṃ trāsotkampapayodharām ॥39॥
rāvaṇena hṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā daurhṛdo me mahānayam । yakṛtplīhaṃ mahat kroḍaṃ hṛdayam ca sabandham ॥40॥
gātrāny api tathā śīrṣaṃ khādeyam iti me matiḥ । tatas tu praghasā nāma rākṣasī vākyam abravīt ॥41॥
kaṇṭham asyā nṛśaṃsāyāḥ pīḍayāmaḥ kim āsyate । nivedyatāṃ tato rājñe mānuṣī sā mṛteti ha ॥42॥
nātra kaś cana saṃdehaḥ khādateti sa vakṣyati । tatas tv ajāmukhī nāma rākṣasī vākyam abravīt ॥43॥
viśasyemāṃ tataḥ sarvān samān kuruta piṇḍakān । vibhajāma tataḥ sarvā vivādo me na rocate ॥44॥
peyam ānīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ mālyaṃ ca vividhaṃ bahu । tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī vākyam abravīt ॥45॥
ajāmukhā yad uktaṃ vai tad eva mama rocate । surā cānīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ sarvaśokavināśinī ॥46॥
aśmasāramidaṃ nūnam athavāpy ajarāmaram । hṛdayaṃ mama yenedaṃ na duḥkhena viśīryate ॥6॥
anviṣya rakṣasāṃ laṅkāṃ kuryād rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ । na hi tābhyāṃ ripur dṛṣṭo muhūrtam api jīvati ॥23॥
citādhūmākulapathā gṛdhramaṇḍalamaṇditā । acireṇaiva laṅkeyaṃ (GP kālena) śmaśānasadṛśī bhavet ॥24॥
sa ca me vihito mṛtyur asmin duṣṭena vartate । akāryaṃ ye na jānanti nairṛtāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ॥33॥
adharmāt tu mahotpāto bhaviṣyati hi sāmpratam । naite dharmaṃ vijānanti rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ ॥34॥
dhruvaṃ māṃ prātarāśārthe rākṣasaḥ kalpayiṣyati । sāhaṃ kathaṃ kariṣyāmi taṃ vinā priyadarśanam ॥35॥
uvāca vacanaṃ kāle trijaṭā svapnasaṃśritam । gajadantamayīṃ divyāṃ śibikām antarikṣagām ॥9॥
yuktāṃ vājisahasreṇa svayam āsthāya rāghavaḥ । śuklamālyāmbaradharo lakṣmaṇena samāgataḥ ॥10॥
rāmeṇa saṃgatā sītā bhāskareṇa prabhā yathā । rāghavaś ca punar dṛṣṭaś caturdantaṃ mahāgajam ॥12॥
ārūḍhaḥ śailasaṃkāśaṃ cakāsa sahalakṣmaṇaḥ । tatas tu suryasaṃkāśau dīpyamānau svatejasā ॥13॥
śuklamālyāmbaradharau jānakīṃ paryupasthitau । tatas tasya nagasyāgre hy ākāśasthasya dantinaḥ ॥14॥
bhartrā parigṛhītasya jānakī skandham āśritā । bhartur aṅkāt samutpatya tataḥ kamalalocanā ॥15॥
śuklamālyāmbaradharo lakṣmaṇena samāgataḥ । tato 'nyatra mayā dṛṣṭo rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ॥18॥
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā saha vīryavān । āruhya puṣpakaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ sūryasaṃnibham ॥19॥
uttaraṃ diśām ālokya prasthitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ । evaṃ svapne mayā dṛṣṭo rāmo viṣṇuparākramaḥ ॥20॥
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā saha bhāryayā । na hi rāmo mahātejāḥ śakyo jetuṃ surāsuraiḥ ॥21॥
rākṣasair vāpi cānyair vā svargaḥ pāpajaneiriva । rāvaṇaś ca mayā dṛṣṭo muṇḍas tailasamukṣitaḥ ॥22॥
raktavāsāḥ pibanmattaḥ karavīrakṛtasrajaḥ । vimānāt puṣpakād adya rāvaṇaḥ patito ksitau ॥23॥
kṛṣyamāṇaḥ striyā muṇḍo dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāmbaraḥ punaḥ । rathena kharayuktena raktamālyānulepanaḥ ॥24॥
pibaṃs tailaṃ hasannṛtyan bhrāntacittākulendriyaḥ । gardabhena yayau śīghraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āsthitaḥ ॥25॥
punareva mayā dṛṣṭo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ । patito 'vākśirā bhūmau gardabhād bhayamohitaḥ ॥26॥
sahasotthāya sambhrānto bhayārto madavihvalaḥ । unmattarūpo digvāsā durvākyaṃ pralapan bahu ॥27॥
durgandhaṃ duḥsahaṃ ghoraṃ timiraṃ narakopamam । malapaṅkaṃ praviśyāśu magnas tatra sa rāvaṇaḥ ॥28॥
prasthito dakṣiṇām āśāṃ praviṣṭo 'kardamaṃ hradam । kaṇṭhe baddhvā daśagrīvaṃ pramadā raktavāsinī ॥29॥
kālī kardamaliptāṅgī diśaṃ yāmyāṃ prakarṣati । evaṃ tatra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābahaḥ ॥30॥
rāvaṇasya sutāḥ sarve muṇḍās tailasamukṣitāḥ । varāheṇa daśagrīvaḥ śiśumāreṇa cendrajit ॥31॥
uṣṭreṇa kumbhakarṇaś ca prayāto dakṣiṇāṃ diśam । ekas tatra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ śvetacchatro vibhīṣaṇaḥ ॥32॥
śuklamālyāmbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ । śaṅkhadundhubhinirghoṣair nṛttagītair alaṃkṛtaḥ ॥33॥
āruhya śailasaṃkāśaṃ meghastanitaniḥsvanam । caturdantaṃ gajaṃ divyam āste tatra vibhīṣaṇaḥ ॥34॥
caturbhiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ vaihāyasam upasthitaḥ ॥35॥
laṅkā dṛṣṭā mayā svapne rāvaṇenābhiraksitā । dagdhā rāmasya dūtena vānareṇa tarasvinā ॥38॥
tataḥ sā hrīmatī bālā bharturvijayaharṣitā । avocad yadi tat tathyaṃ bhaveyaṃ śaraṇaṃ hi vaḥ ॥54॥
tasminn anāgacchati lokanāthe । garbhasthajantor iva śalyakṛntaḥ । nūnaṃ mamāṅgāny acirād anāryaḥ । śastraiḥ śitaiś chetsyati rākṣasendraḥ ॥6॥
rājarṣīṇāṅ guṇaśrēṣṭhas tapasā carṣibhiḥ samaḥ । cakravartikule jātaḥ puraṃdarasamo bale ॥3॥
janasthānavadhaṃ śrutvā nihatau kharadūṣaṇau । tatas tv amarṣāpahṛtā jānakī rāvaṇena tu ॥10॥
vañcayitvā vane rāmaṃ mṛgarūpeṇa māyayā । sa mārgamāṇas tāṃ dēvīṃ rāmaḥ sītām aninditām ॥11॥
āsasāda vane mitraṃ sugrīvaṃ nāma vānaram । tataḥ sa vālinaṅ hatvā rāmaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ ॥12॥
āyacchat kapirājyaṃ tu sugrīvāya mahātmane । sugrīvēṇābhisaṃdiṣṭā harayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ॥13॥
dikṣu sarvāsu tāṃ devīṃ vicinvantaḥ sahasraśaḥ । ahaṃ sampātivacanāc chatayōjanamāyatam ॥14॥
asyā hetor viśālākṣyāḥ sāgaraṃ vegavān plutaḥ । yathārūpāṃ yathāvarṇāṃ tathālakṣmavatīṃ ca tām ॥15॥
aśrauṣaṃ rāghavasyāhaṃ seyam āsāditā mayā । virarāmaivam uktvā sa vācaṃ vānarapuṃgavaḥ ॥16॥
niśamya sītā vacanaṃ kapeśca । diśaśca sarvāḥ pradiśaśca vīkṣya । svayaṃ praharṣam paramaṃ jagāma । sarvātmanā rāmam anusmarantī ॥18॥
sā dadarśa kapiṃ tatra praśritaṃ priyavādinam । phullāśokotkarābhāsaṃ taptacāmīkarekṣaṇam ॥2॥
ahō bhīmamidaṃ sattvaṃ vānarasya durāsadam । durnirīkṣamidaṃ matvā punareva mumoha sā ॥4॥
vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ sītā karuṇaṃ bhayamohitā । rāma rāmēti duḥkhārtā lakṣmaṇēti ca bhāminī ॥5॥
ruroda sahasā sītā mandamandasvarā satī । sātha dṛṣtvā harivaraṃ vinītavad upagatam । maithilī cintayām āsa svapno 'yam iti bhaminī ॥6॥
sā vīkṣamāṇā pṛthubhugnavaktraṃ । śākhāmṛgendrasya yathoktakāram । dadarśa piṅgpravaraṃ mahārhaṃ । vātātmajaṃ buddhimatāṃ variṣṭham ॥7॥
rāmeti rāmeti sadaiva buddhyā । vicintya vācā bruvatī tameva । tasyānurūpāṃ ca kathāṃ tadartham । evaṃ prapaśyāmi tathā śṛṇōmi ॥11॥
so 'vatīrya drumāt tasmād vidrumapratimānanaḥ । vinītaveṣaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ praṇipatyopasṛtya ca ॥1॥
rodanād atiniḥśvāsād bhūmisaṃsparśanādapi । na tvāṃ dēvīm ahaṃ manyē rājñaḥ saṃjñāvadhāraṇāt ॥10॥
yathā hi tava vai dainyaṃ rūpaṃ cāpyatimānuṣam । tapasā cānvito veṣas tvaṃ rāmamahiṣī dhruvam ॥13॥
pṛthivyāṃ rājasiṃhānāṃ mukhyasya viditātmanaḥ । snuṣā daśarathasyāhaṃ śatrusainyapratāpinaḥ ॥15॥
athavā naitadevaṃ hi yan mayā pariśaṅkitam । manaso hi mama prītir utpannā tava darśanāt ॥17॥
śūnye yenāpanītāsi tasya drakṣyasi yat phalam । acirād rāvaṇaṃ saṃkhye yo vadhiṣyati vīryavān ॥32॥
krodhapramuktair iṣubhir jvaladbhir iva pāvakaiḥ । tenāhaṃ preṣito dūtas tvatsakāśam ihāgataḥ ॥33॥
tvadviyogena duḥkhārtaḥ sa tvāṃ kauśalam abravīt । lakṣmaṇaś ca mahātejā sumitrānandavardhanaḥ ॥34॥
abhivādya mahābāhuḥ sa tvāṃ kauśalam abravīt । rāmasya ca sakhā devi sugrīvo nāma vānaraḥ ॥35॥
rājā vānaramukhyānāṃ sa tvāṃ kauśalam abravīt । nityaṃ smarati rāmas tvāṃ sasugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ॥36॥
diṣṭyā jīvasi vaidehi rākṣasī vaśam āgatā । nacirād drakṣyase rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahāratham ॥37॥
madhye vānarakoṭīnāṃ sugrīvaṃ cāmitaujasaṃ । ahaṃ sugrīvasacivo hanūmān nāma vānaraḥ ॥38॥
praviṣṭo nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ laṅghayitvā mahodadhim । kṛtvā mūrdhni padanyāsaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ॥39॥
trivalīvāṃs tryavaṇataś caturvyaṅgas triśīrṣavān । catuṣkalaś caturlekhaś catuṣkiṣkuś catuḥ samaḥ ॥18॥
caturdaśasamadvandvaś caturdaṣṭaś caturgatiḥ । mahauṣṭhahanunāsaś ca pañcasnigdho 'ṣṭavaṃśavān ॥19॥
daśapadmo daśabṛhat tribhir vyāpto dviśuklavān । ṣaḍunnato navatanus tribhir vyāpnoti rāghavaḥ ॥20॥
vaimātra - descended from another mother । sa suvarṇacchaviḥ śrīmān rāmaḥ śyāmo mahāyaśāḥ । tāvubhau naraśārḍūlau tvaddarśanakṛtotsavau ॥23॥
vicinvanau mahīm kṛtsnām asmābhiḥ saha samgātau । tvām eva mārgamāṇau tau vicarantau vasuṃdharām ॥24॥
dadarśatur mṛgapatiṃ pūrvajenāvaropitam । ṛśyamūkasya mūle tu bahupādapasaṃkule ॥25॥
bhrātur bhāyārtam āsīnaṃ sugrīvaṃ priyadarśanam । vayaṃ tu harirājaṃ taṃ sugrīvaṃ satyasaṃgaram ॥26॥
paricaryāmahe rājyāt pūrvajenāvaropitam । tatas tau cīravasanau dhanuḥpravarapāṇinau ॥27॥
ṛśyamūkasya śailasya ramyaṃ deśam upāgatau । sa tau dṛṣṭvā naravyāghrau dhanvinau vānararṣabhaḥ ॥28॥
abhipluto gires tasya śikharaṃ bhayamohitaḥ । tataḥ sa śikhare tasmin vānarendro vyavasthitaḥ ॥29॥
tayoḥ samīpaṃ mām eva preṣayām āsa satvaraṃ । tāv ahaṃ puruṣavyāghrau sugrīvavacanāt prabhū ॥30॥
rūpalakṣaṇasaṃpannau kṛtāñjalir upasthitaḥ । tau parijñātatattvārthau mayā prītisamanvitau ॥31॥
pṛṣṭham āropya taṃ deśaṃ prāpitau puruṣarṣabhau । niveditau ca tattvena sugrīvāya mahātmane ॥32॥
tayor anyonyasaṃbhāṣād bhṛśaṃ prītir ajāyata । tatra tau kīrtisaṃpannau harīśvaranareśvarau ॥33॥
parasparakṛtāśvāsau kathayā pūrvavṛttayā । taṃ tataḥ sāntvayām āsa sugrīvaṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ॥34॥
strīhetor vālinā bhrātrā nirastam purutejasā । tatas tvannāśajaṃ śokaṃ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ॥35॥
lakṣmaṇo vānarendrāya sugrīvāya nyavedayat । sa śrutvā vānarendras tu lakṣmaṇeneritaṃ vacaḥ ॥36॥
tadāsīn niṣprabho 'tyarthaṃ grahagrasta ivāṃśumān । tatas tvadgātraśobhīni rakṣasā hriyamāṇayā ॥37॥
yāny ābharaṇajālāni pātitāni mahītale । tāni sarvāṇi rāmāya ānīya hariyūthapāḥ ॥38॥
saṃhṛṣṭā darśayām āsur gatiṃ tu na vidus tava । tāni rāmāya dattāni mayaivopahṛtāni ca ॥39॥
svanavanty avakīrṇanti tasmin vihatacetasi । tāny aṅke darśanīyāni kṛtvā bahuvidhaṃ tataḥ ॥40॥
tena devaprakāśena devena paridevitam । paśyatas tasyā rudatas tāmyataś ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥41॥
tatas tābhyāṃ kumarābhyāṃ vīrābhyāṃ sa harīśvaraḥ । kiṣkindhāṃ samupāgamya vālī yuddhe nipatitaḥ ॥51॥
tatas te mārgamāṇā vai sugrīvavacanāturā । caranti vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃ vayam anye ca vānarāḥ ॥56॥
tatas tasya girer mūrdhni vayaṃ prāyamupāsmahe । dṛṣṭvā prāyopaviṣṭāṃś ca sarvān vānarapuṃgavān ॥61॥
prāyopaveśam asmākaṃ maraṇaṃ ca jaṭāyuṣaḥ । teṣāṃ naḥ svāmisaṃdeśān nirāśānāṃ mumūrṣatām ॥63॥
kāryahetor ivāyātaḥ śakunir vīryavān mahān । gṛdhrarājasya sodaryaḥ saṃpātir nāma gṛdhrarāṭ ॥64॥
śrutvā bhrātṛvadhaṃ kopād idaṃ vacanam abravīt । yavīyān kena me bhrātā hataḥ kva ca nipātitaḥ ॥65॥
etad ākhyātum icchāmi bhavadbhir vānarottamāḥ । aṅgado 'kathayat tasya janasthāne mahad vadham ॥66॥
rakṣasā bhīmarūpeṇa tvām uddiśya yathārthataḥ । jaṭāyos tu vadhaṃ śrutvā duḥkhitaḥ so 'ruṇātmajaḥ ॥67॥
tvām āha sa varārohe vasantīṃ rāvaṇālaye । tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃpāteḥ prītivardhanam ॥68॥
aṅgadapramukhāḥ sarve tataḥ prasthāpitā vayam । vindhyād utthāya samprāptāḥ sāgarasyāntam uttamam ॥69॥
tvaddarśane kṛtotsāhā hṛṣṭās tuṣṭāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ । aṅgadapramukhāḥ sarve velopāntam upāgatāḥ ॥70॥
cintāṃ jagmuḥ punarbhīmām tvaddarśanasamutsukāḥ । athāhaṃ harisainyasya sāgaraṃ dṛśya sīdataḥ ॥71॥
vyavadhūya bhayaṃ tīvraṃ yojanānāṃ śataṃ plutaḥ । laṅkā cāpi mayā rātrau praviṣṭā rākṣasākulā ॥72॥
rāvaṇaś ca mayā dṛṣṭas tvaṃ ca śokanipīḍitā । etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ yathāvṛttam anindite ॥73॥
abhibhāṣasva māṃ devi dūto dāśarather aham । tan māṃ rāmakṛtodyogaṃ tvannimittam ihāgatam ॥74॥
sugrīvasacivaṃ devi budhyasva pavanātmajam । kuśalī tava kākutsthaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ॥75॥
guror ārādhane yukto lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ । tasya vīryavato devi bhartus tava hite rataḥ ॥76॥
aham ekas tu saṃprāptaḥ sugrīvavacanād iha । mayeyam asahāyena caratā kāmarūpiṇā ॥77॥
dakṣiṇā dig anukrāntā tvanmārgavicayaiṣiṇā । diṣṭyāhaṃ harisainyānāṃ tvannāśam anuśocatām ॥78॥
apaneṣyāmi saṃtāpaṃ tavādhigamaśaṃsanāt । diṣṭyā hi na mama vyarthaṃ sāgarasyeha laṅghanam ॥79॥
prāpsyāmy aham idaṃ devi tvaddarśanakṛtaṃ yaśaḥ । rāghavaś ca mahāvīryaḥ kṣipraṃ tvām abhipatsyate ॥80॥
saputrabāndhavaṃ hatvā rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam । mālyavān nāma vaidehi girīṇām uttamo giriḥ ॥81॥
viśvāsārthaṃ tu vaidehi bhartur uktā mayā guṇāḥ । acirāt tvām ito devi rāghavo nayitā dhruvam ॥84॥
etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ samāśvasihi maithili । kiṃ karomi kathaṃ vā te rocate pratiyāmyaham ॥89॥
pratyayārthaṃ tavānītaṃ tena dattaṃ mahātmanā । samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te kṣīṇaduḥkhaphalā hy asi ॥3॥
śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṃ kṣipram eṣyati rāghavaḥ । camūṃ prakarṣan mahatīṃ haryṛṣkagaṇasaṃkulām ॥34॥
viṣṭambhayitvā bāṇaughair akṣobhyaṃ varuṇālayam । kariṣyati purīṃ laṅkāṃ kākutsthaḥ śāntarākṣasām ॥35॥
pariśramāc ca suptā ca rāghavāṅke 'smy ahaṃ ciram । paryāyeṇa prasuptaśca mamāṅke bharatāgrajaḥ ॥21॥
sa tatra punarevātha vāyasaḥ samupāgamat । tataḥ suptaprabuddhāṃ māṃ rāghavāṅkāt samutthitām । vāyasaḥ sahasāgamya vidadāra stanāntare ॥22॥
punaḥ punarathotpatya vidadāra sa māṃ bhṛśam । tataḥ samutthito rāmo muktaiḥ śoṇitabindubhiḥ ॥23॥
sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābāhur vitunnāṃ stanayos tadā । āśīviṣa iva kruddhaḥ śvasān vākyam abhāṣata ॥24॥
kena te nāganāsoru vikṣataṃ vai stanāntaram । kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā ॥25॥
sa taṃ pradīptaṃ cikṣēpa darbhaṃ taṃ vāyasaṃ prati । tatas taṃ vāyasaṃ darbhaḥ so 'mbare 'nujagāma ha ॥30॥
anusṛṣṭas tadā kālo jagāma vividhāṃ gatim । trāṇakāma imaṃ lokaṃ sarvaṃ vai vicacāra ha ॥31॥
sa kuruṣva mahotsāhāṃ kṛpāṃ mayi nararṣabha । tvayā nāthavatī nātha hyanāthā iva dṛśyate ॥38॥
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmas tvatta eva mayā śrutam । jānāmi tvāṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahābalam ॥39॥
apāravāram akṣobhyaṃ gāmbhīryāt sāgaropamam । bhartāraṃ sasamudrāyā dharaṇyā vāsavopamam ॥40॥
vaidehyā vacanaṃ śrutvā karuṇaṃ sāśru bhāṣitam । athābravīn mahātējā hanuman hariyūthapaḥ ॥47॥
tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena te śape । rāme duḥkhābhipanne ca lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate ॥48॥
kathaṃ cid bhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ pariśocitum । imaṃ muhūrtaṃ duḥkhānām antaṃ drakṣyasi śobhane ॥49॥
tāvubhau puruṣavyāghrau rājaputrau mahābalau । tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhau lokān bhasmīkariṣyataḥ ॥50॥
hatvā ca samarakrūraṃ rāvaṇaṃ sahabāndhavam । rāghavas tvāṃ viśālākṣi svāṃ purīṃ prati neṣyati ॥51॥
brūhi yad rāghavo vācyo lakṣmaṇaś ca mahābalaḥ । sugrīvo vāpi tejasvī harayo 'pi samāgatāḥ ॥52॥
ityuktavati tasmiṃś ca sītā punar athābravīt । kausalyā lokabhartāraṃ suṣuve yaṃ manasvinī ॥53॥
taṃ mamārthe sukhaṃ pṛccha śirasā cābhivādaya । srajaś ca sarvaratnāni priyā yāś ca varāṅganāḥ ॥54॥
aiśvaryaṃ ca viśālāyāṃ pṛthivyām api durlabham । pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva sammānyābhiprasādya ca ॥55॥
anupravrajito rāmaṃ sumitrā yena suprajāḥ । ānukūlyena dharmātmā tyaktvā sukham anuttamam ॥56॥
mṛdur nityaṃ śucir dakṣaḥ priyo rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ । yathā hi vānaraśreṣṭha duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet ॥62॥
tvam asmin kāryanirvahe pramāṇaṃ hariyūthapa । rāghavas tvatsamārambhān mayi yatnaparo bhavet ॥63॥
hanuman yatnamāsthāya duḥkhakṣayakaro bhava । sa tatheti pratijñāya mārutir bhīmavikramaḥ ॥5॥
śirasāvandya vaidehīṃ gamanāyopacakrame । jñātvā samprasthitaṃ devī vānaraṃ pavanātmajam ॥6॥
bāṣpagadgadayā vācā maithilī vākyam abravīt । hanuman kuśalaṃ brūyāḥ sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau ॥7॥
sugrīvaṃ ca sahāmātyaṃ sarvān vṛddhāṃś ca vānarān । brūyās tvaṃ vānaraśrēṣṭha kuśalaṃ dharmasaṃhitam ॥8॥
śraddheyaṃ hanuman vākyaṃ tava vīra bhaviṣyati । sa taṃ maṇivaraṃ gṛhya śrīmān plavagasattamaḥ ॥19॥
praṇamya śirasā devīṃ gamanāyopacakrame । tam utpātakṛtotsāham avekṣya hariyūthapam ॥20॥
vardhamānaṃ mahāvegam uvāca janakātmajā । aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpagadgadayā girā ॥21॥
tataḥ samāsādya raṇe daśānanaṃ । samantrivargaṃ sabalaṃ sayāyinam । hṛdi sthitaṃ tasya mataṃ balaṃ ca । sukhena mattvāhamitaḥ punar vraje ॥9॥
nānāśakuntavirutaiḥ prabhinnasalilāśayaiḥ । tāmraiḥ kisalayaiḥ klāntaiḥ klāntadrumalatāyutaiḥ ॥17॥
na babhau tad vanaṃ tatra dāvānalahataṃ yathā । vyākulāvaraṇā rejur vihvalā iva tā latāḥ ॥18॥
sā vihvalāśokalatāpratānā । vanasthalī śokalatāpratānā । jātā daśāsyapramadāvanasya । kapērbalāddhi pramadāvanasya ॥20॥
tasya kruddhasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannāsrabindavaḥ । dīptābhyāmiva dīpābhyāṃ sārciṣaḥ snehabindavaḥ ॥23॥
mudgaraiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ prāsatomarapāṇayaḥ । parivārya hanūmantaṃ sahasā tasthuragrataḥ ॥29॥
sa bhūtvā tu mahākāyo hanuman mārutātmajaḥ । puccham āsphoṭayāmāsa laṅkāṃ śabdena pūrayan ॥31॥
tasyāsphoṭitaśabdena mahatā sānunādinā । petur vihaṃgā gaganād uccaiś cedamaghoṣayat ॥32॥
jayatyatibalo rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ । rājā jayati sugrīvo rāghaveṇābhipālitaḥ ॥33॥
dāso 'haṃ kosalendrasya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ । hanumāñśatrusainyānāṃ nihantā mārutātmajaḥ ॥34॥
na rāvaṇasahasraṃ me yuddhe pratibalaṃ bhavet । śilābhiś ca praharataḥ pādapaiśca sahasraśaḥ ॥35॥
ardayitvā purīṃ laṅkām abhivādya ca maithilīm । samṛddhārtho gamiṣyāmi miṣatāṃ sarvarakṣasām ॥36॥
vicacārāmbare vīraḥ parigṛhya ca mārutiḥ । sūdayamāsa vajreṇa daityān iva sahasradṛk ॥41॥
tasmāt prāsādam adyaivam imaṃ vidhvaṃsayāmy aham । iti saṃcintya hanumān manasā darśayan balam ॥2॥
caityaprāsādam utlutya meruśṛṅgam ivonnatam । āruroha hariśreṣṭho hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ॥3॥
āruhya girisaṃkāśaṃ prāsādaṃ hariyūthapaḥ । babhau sa sumahātejāḥ pratisūrya ivoditaḥ ॥4॥
visṛjanto mahākayā mārutiṃ paryavārayan । te gadābhir vicitrābhiḥ parighaiḥ kāñcanāṅgadaiḥ ॥14॥
ājagmur vānaraśrēṣṭhaṃ bāṇaiś cādityasannibhaiḥ । āvarta iva gaṅgāyāstoyasya vipulo mahān ॥15॥
tatas taṃ bhrāmayām āsa śatadhāraṃ mahābalaḥ । tatra cāgniḥ samabhavat prāsādaś cāpy adahyata ॥18॥
dahyamānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā prāsādaṃ hariyūthapaḥ । sa rākṣasaśataṃ hatvā vajreṇendra ivāsurān ॥19॥
antarikṣasthitaḥ śrīmān idaṃ vacanam abravīt । mādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi visṛṣṭāni mahātmanām ॥20॥
balināṃ vānarendrāṇāṃ sugrīvavaśavartinām । aṭanti vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃṅ vayam anye ca vānarāḥ ॥21॥
daśanāgabalāḥ kecit kecid daśaguṇottarāḥ । kecin nāgasahasrasya babhūvus tulyavikramāḥ ॥22॥
santi caughabalāḥ kecit kecid vāyubalopamāḥ । aprameyabalāḥ kecit tatrāsan hariyūthapāḥ ॥23॥
īdṛgvidhais tu haribhir vṛto dantanakhāyudhaiḥ । śataiḥ śatasahasraiś ca koṭībhiś cāyutair api ॥24॥
tattasya raktaṃ raktena rañjitaṅ śuśubhe mukham । yathākāśe mahāpadmaṃ siktaṃ kāñcanabindubhiḥ ॥9॥
sravatā rudhireṇātha sravantyo darśitāḥ pathi । vividhaiś ca svanair laṅkā nanāda vikṛtaṃ tadā ॥16॥
vānaro 'yam iti jñātvā na hi śuddhyati me manaḥ । naivāhaṃ taṃ kapiṃ manye yatheyaṃ prastutā kathā ॥7॥
bhaved indreṇa vā sṛṣṭam asmadarthaṃ tapobalāt । sanāgayakṣagandharvā devāsuramaharṣayaḥ ॥8॥
yuṣmābhiḥ sahitaiḥ sarvair mayā saha vinirjitāḥ । tair avaśyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ vyalīkaṃ kiṃ cid eva naḥ ॥9॥
tad eva nātra saṃdehaḥ prasahya parigṛhyatām । yāta senāgragāḥ sarve mahābalaparigrahāḥ ॥10॥
savājirathamātaṅgāḥ sa kapiḥ śāsyatām iti । nāvamanyo bhavadbhiś ca kapir dhīraparākramaḥ ॥11॥
dṛṣṭā hi harayaḥ pūrve mayā vipulavikramāḥ । vālī ca saha sugrīvo jāmbavāṃś ca mahābalaḥ ॥12॥
nīlaḥ senāpatiś caiva ye cānye dvividādayaḥ । naiva teṣāṃ gatir bhīmā na tejo na parākramaḥ ॥13॥
na matir na balotsāho na rūpaparikalpanam । mahat sattvam idaṃ jñeyaṃ kapirūpaṃ vyavasthitam ॥14॥
prayatnaṃ mahad āsthāya kriyatām asya nigrahaḥ । kāmaṃ lokās trayaḥ sendrāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ ॥15॥
bhavatām agrataḥ sthātuṃ na paryāptā raṇājire । tathāpi tu nayajñena jayam ākāṅkṣatā raṇe ॥16॥
ātmā rakṣyaḥ prayatnena yuddhasiddhir hi cañcalā । te svāmivacanaṃ sarve pratigṛhya mahaujasaḥ ॥17॥
samutpetur mahāvegā hutāśasamatejasaḥ । rathaiś ca mattair nāgaiś ca vājibhiś ca mahājavaiḥ ॥18॥
śastraiś ca vividhais tīkṣṇaiḥ sarvaiś copahitā balaiḥ । tatas tu dadṛśur vīrā dīpyamānaṃ mahākapim ॥19॥
raśmimantam ivodyantaṃ svatejoraśmimālinam । toraṇasthaṃ mahāvegaṃ mahāsattvaṃ mahābalam ॥20॥
mahāmatiṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahābhujam । taṃ samīkṣyaiva te sarve dikṣu sarvāsv avasthitāḥ ॥21॥

mahākapir bhūmitale nipīḍya taṃ । cakāra rakṣo'dhipater mahad bhayam । maharṣibhiś cakracarair samāgataiḥ । sametya bhūtaiś ca sayakṣapannagaiḥ । suraiś ca sendrair bhṛśajātavismayair । hate kumāre sa kapir nirīkṣitaḥ ॥37॥
na kaś cit triṣu lokeṣu saṃyugena gataśramaḥ । bhujavīryābhiguptaśca tapasā cābhirakṣitaḥ । deśakālapradhānaś ca tvameva matisattamaḥ । (var. deśakālavibhāgajñas tvameva…) ॥4॥
na vīra senā gaṇaśaś cyavanti । na vajramādāya viśālasāram । na mārutasyāsti gatipramāṇaṃ । na cāgnikalpaḥ karaṇena hantum ॥11॥
tamevamarthaṃ prasamīkṣya samyak । svakarmasāmyāddhi samāhitātmā । smaraṃśca divyaṃ dhanuṣo 'sya vīryaṃ । vrajākṣataṃ karma samārabhasva ॥12॥
śaṅkāhṛtātmā dadhyau sa kapīndraṃ tejasā vṛtam । kim eṣa bhagavān nandī bhavet sākṣād ihāgataḥ ॥2॥
yena śapto ’smi kailāse mayā prahasite purā । so 'yaṃ vānaramūrtiḥ syāt kiṃ svid bāṇo 'pi vāsuraḥ ॥3॥
matpurīm apradhṛṣyāṃ vai gamane kiṃ prayōjanam । āyodhane vā kiṃ kāryaṃ pṛcchayatām eṣa durmatiḥ ॥6॥
abravīn nāsmi śakrasya yamasya varuṇasya ca । dhanadena na me sakhyaṃ viṣṇunā nāsmi coditaḥ ॥13॥
jātir eva mama tv eṣā vānaro 'ham ihāgataḥ । darśane rākṣasendrasya tad idaṃ durlabhaṃ mayā ॥14॥
vanaṃ rākṣasarājasya darśanārthe vināśitam । tatas te rākṣasāḥ prāptā balino yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ॥15॥
rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca dehasya pratiyuddhā mayā raṇe । astrapāśair na śakyo 'haṃ baddhuṃ devāsurair api ॥16॥
pitāmahād eṣa varo mamāpi hi samāgataḥ । rājānaṃ draṣṭukāmena mayāstram anuvartitam ॥17॥
vimukto 'py aham astreṇa rākṣasais tv abhiveditaḥ । kenacid rāmakaryeṇa āgato 'smi tavāntikam ॥18॥ dūto 'ham iti vijñayo rāghavasyāmitaujasaḥ ॥18॥
tvayā vijñātapūrvaśca vālī vānarapuṅgavaḥ । sa tena nihataḥ saṃkhye śareṇaikena vānaraḥ ॥11॥
samudraṃ laṅghayitvaiva tvāṃ didṛkṣur ihāgataḥ । bhramatā ca mayā dṛṣṭā gṛhe te janakātmajā ॥16॥
svāni mitrāṇi mantrīṃś ca jñātīn bhrātṝn sutān hitān । bhogān dārāṃś ca laṅkāṃ ca mā vināśamupānaya ॥37॥
satyaṃ rākṣasarājendra śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ mama । rāmadāsasya dūtasya vānarasya viśeṣataḥ ॥38॥
sarvān lōkān susaṃhṛtya sabhūtān sacarācarān । punareva tathā sraṣṭuṃ śakto rāmo mahāyaśāḥ ॥39॥
devāsuranarendreṣu yakṣarakṣorageṣu ca । vidyādhareṣu nāgeṣu gandharveṣu mṛgeṣu ca ॥40॥
siddheṣu kinnarendreṣu patatriṣu ca sarvataḥ । sarvatra sarvabhūteṣu sarvalokeṣu nāsti saḥ ॥41॥
yo rāmaṃ pratiyudhyeta viṣṇutulyaparākramam । sarvalokeśvarasyeha kṛtvā vipriyam īdṛśam । rāmasya rājasiṃhasya durlabhaṃ tava jīvitam ॥42॥
devāśca daityāśca niśācarendra । gandharvavidyādharanāgayakṣāḥ । rāmasya lokatrayanāyakasya । sthātuṃ na śaktāḥ samareṣu sarve ॥43॥
brahmā svayambhūś caturānano vā । rudras triṇetras tripurāntako vā । indro mahendraḥ suranāyako vā । sthātuṃ na śaktā yudhi rāghavasya ॥44॥
kṣamasva roṣaṃ tyaja rākṣasendra । prasīda madvākyam idaṃ śṛṇuṣva । vadhaṃ na kurvanti parāvarajñā । dūtasya santo vasudhādhipendrāḥ ॥5॥
dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca rājadharmaviśāradaḥ । parāvarajño bhūtānāṃ tvameva paramārthavit ॥7॥
gṛhyante yadi roṣeṇa tvādṛśo 'pi vicakṣaṇaḥ । tataḥ śāstravipaścittvaṃ śrama eva hi kevalam ॥8॥
tasmāt prasīda śatrughna rākṣasendra durāsada । yuktāyuktaṃ viniścitya dūtadaṇḍo vidhīyatām ॥9॥
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ । roṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo vākyam uttaram abravīt ॥10॥
na pāpānāṃ vadhe pāpaṃ vidyate śatrusūdana । tasmād imaṃ vadhiṣyāmi vānaraṃ pāpakāriṇam ॥11॥
adharmamūlaṃ bahudoṣayuktam । anāryajuṣṭaṃ vacanaṃ niśamya । uvāca vākyaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ । vibhīṣaṇo buddhimatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ॥12॥
prasīda laṅkeśvara rākṣasendra । dharmārthayuktaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇuṣva । dūtā na vadhyāḥ samayeṣu rājan । sarveṣu sarvatra vadanti santaḥ ॥13॥
parākramotsāhamanasvināṃ ca । surāsurāṇam api durjayena । tvayāprameyeṇa surendrasaṃdhā । jitāś ca yuddheṣv asakṛn narendrāḥ ॥18॥
itthaṃvidhasyāmaradaytaśatroḥ । śūrasya vīrasya tavājitasya । kurvanti vīrā manasāpyalīkaṃ । prāṇair vimuktā na tu bhoḥ purā te ॥19॥
niśācarāṇāmadhipo 'nujasya । vibhīṣaṇasyuttamavākyam iṣṭam । jagrāha buddhyā suralokaśatrur । mahābalo rākṣasarājamukhyaḥ ॥28॥

roṣāmarṣaparītātmā bālasūryasamānanaḥ । sa bhūyaḥ saṃgataiḥ krūrai rākasair harispuṃgavaḥ । (or) lāṅgūlaṃ sampradīptaṃ tu draṣṭuṃ tasya hanūmataḥ । sahastrībālavṛddhāś ca jagmuḥ prītā niśācarāḥ । (or) lāṅgūlaṃ sampradīptaṃ tu dṛṣtvā tasya hanūmataḥ । sahastrībālavṛddhāś ca jagmuḥ prītiṃ niśācarāḥ ॥9॥
sahastrībālavṛddhāś ca jagmuḥ prītiṃ niśācarāḥ । nibaddhaḥ kṛtavān vīras tatkālasadṛśīṃ matim ॥10॥
yadi bhartṛhitārthāya carantaṃ bhartṛśāsanāt । nibadhnante durātmano na tu me niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā ॥12॥
avaśyam eva draṣṭavyā mayā laṅkā niśākṣaye । kāmaṃ bandhnantu ca me bhūyaḥ pucchasyoddīpanena ca ॥15॥
pīḍāṃ kurvanti rakṣāṃsi na me 'sti manasaḥ śramaḥ । tatas te saṃvṛtākāraṃ sattvavantaṃ mahākapim ॥16॥
parigṛhya yayur hṛṣṭā rākṣasāḥ kapikuñjaram । śaṅkhabherīninādaiś ca ghoṣayantaḥ svakarmabhiḥ ॥17॥
rākṣasāḥ krūrakarmāṇaś cārayanti sma tāṃ purīm । anvīyamano rakṣobhir yayau sukham ariṃdamaḥ ॥18॥
tathā rathyoparathyāśca tathaiva gṛhakāntarān । catvareṣu catuṣkeṣu rājamārge tathaiva ca ॥21॥
ghoṣayanti kapiṃ sarve cāra ityeva rākṣasāḥ । strībālavṛddhā nirjagmus tatra tatra kutūhalāt ॥22॥
taṃ pradīpitalāṅgūlaṃ hanumantaṃ didṛkṣavaḥ । dīpyamāne tatas tasya lāṅgūlāgre hanūmataḥ ॥23॥
rākṣasyas tā virūpākṣyaḥ śaṃsur devyās tad apriyam । yas tvayā kṛtasaṃvādaḥ sīte tāmramukhaḥ kapiḥ ॥24॥
lāṅgūlena pradīptena sa eṣa pariṇīyate । śrutvā tad vacanaṃ krūram ātmāpaharaṇopamam ॥25॥
vaidehī śokasaṃtaptā hutāśanam upāgamat । maṅgalābhimukhī tasya sā tadāsīn mahākapeḥ ॥26॥
hanūmajjanakaś caiva pucchānalayuto 'nilaḥ । vavau svāsthyakaro devyāḥ prāleyānilaśītalaḥ ॥32॥
pratikriyāsya yuktā syāt sati mahyaṃ parākrame । tataś chittvā ca tān pāśān vegavān vai mahākapiḥ ॥39॥
utpapātātha vegena nanāda ca mahākapiḥ । puradvāraṃ tataḥ śrīmāñ śailaśṛṅgam ivonnatam ॥40॥
vibhaktarakṣaḥsambādham āsasādānilātmajaḥ । sa bhūtvā śailasaṃkāśaḥ kṣaṇena punar ātmavān ॥41॥
hrasvatāṃ paramāṃ prāpto bandhanāny avaśātayat । vimuktaś cābhavac chrīmān punaḥ parvatasaṃnibhaḥ ॥42॥
gṛhād gṛhaṃ rākṣasānām udyānāni ca vānaraḥ । vīkṣamāṇo hy asaṃtrastaḥ prāsādāṃś ca cacāra saḥ ॥7॥
avaplutya mahāvegaḥ prahastasya niveśanam । agniṃ tatra vinikṣipya śvasanena samo balī ॥8॥
vajradaṃṣṭrasya ca tathā pupluve sa mahākapiḥ । śukasya ca mahātejāḥ sāraṇasya ca dhīmataḥ ॥10॥
tathā cendrajito veśma dadāha hariyūthapaḥ । jambumāleḥ sumāleśca dadāha bhavanaṃ tataḥ ॥11॥
raśmiketoś ca bhavanaṃ sūryaśatros tathaiva ca । hrasvakarṇasya daṃṣṭrasya romaśasya ca rakṣasaḥ ॥12॥
yuddhonmattasya mattasya dhvajagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ । vidyujjihvasya ghorasya tathā hastimukhasya ca ॥13॥
karālasya viśālasya śoṇitākṣasya caiva hi । kumbhakarṇasya bhavanaṃ makarākṣasya caiva hi ॥14॥
narāntakasya kumbhasya nikumbhasya durātmanaḥ । yajñaśatroś ca bhavanaṃ brahmaśatros tathaiva ca ॥15॥
varjayitvā mahātējā vibhīṣaṇagṛhaṃ prati । kramamāṇaḥ krameṇaiva dadāha haripuṃgavaḥ ॥16॥
teṣu teṣu mahārheṣu bhavaneṣu mahāyaśāḥ । gṛheṣv ṛddhimatām ṛddhiṃ dadāha sa kapikuñjaraḥ ॥17॥
sarveṣāṃ samatikramya rākṣasendrasya vīryavān । āsasādātha lakṣmīvān rāvaṇasya nivēśanam ॥18॥
tatas tasmin gṛhe mukhye nānāratnavibhūṣite । merumandarasaṃkāśe sarvamaṅgalaśobhite ॥19॥
pradīptam agnim utsṛjya lāṅgūlāgre pratiṣṭhitam । nanāda hanumān vīro yugāntajalado yathā ॥20॥
bhavanāny vyaśīryanta ratnavanti mahānti ca । tāni bhagnavimānāni nipetur vasudhātale ॥23॥
bhavanānīva siddhānām ambarāt puṇyasaṃkṣaye । saṃjajñe tumulaḥ śabdo rākṣasānāṃ pradhāvatām ॥24॥
sve sve gṛhaparitrāṇe bhagnotsāhor jitaśriyām । nūnam eṣo 'gnir āyātaḥ kapirūpeṇa hā iti ॥25॥
krandantyaḥ sahasā petuḥ stanaṃdhayadharāḥ striyaḥ । kāścid agniparītāṅgyo harmebhyo muktamūrdhajāḥ ॥26॥
patantyo rejire 'bhrebhyaḥ saudāmanya ivāmbarāt । vajravidrumavaidūryamuktārajatasaṃhatān ॥27॥
vicitrān bhavanād dhātūn syandamānān dadarśa saḥ । nāgnis tṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ ca yathā tathā ॥28॥
hanūmān rākṣasendrāṇāṃ vadhe kiṃ cin na tṛpyati । na hanūmadviśastānāṃ rakṣasānāṃ vasundharā ॥29॥
hanūmatā vegavatā vānareṇa mahātmanā । laṅkāpuram pradagdhaṃ tad rudreṇa tripuraṃ yathā ॥30॥
tataḥ sa laṅkāpuraparvatāgre । samutthito bhīmaparākramo 'gniḥ । prasārya cūḍāvalayaṃ pradīpto । hanūmatā vegavatopasṛṣṭaḥ ॥31॥
yugāntakālānalatulyarūpaḥ । samāruto 'gnir vavṛdhe divispṛk । vidhūmaraśmir bhavaneṣu sakto । rakṣaśśarīrājyasamarpitārciḥ ॥32॥
ādityakoṭīsadṛśaḥ sutejā laṅkāṃ । samastāṃ parivārya tiṣṭhan । śabdair anekair aśaniprarūḍhair । bhindann ivāṇḍaṃ prababhau mahāgniḥ ॥33॥
tatrāmbarād agnir atipravṛddho । rūkṣaprabhaḥ kiṃśukapuṣpacūḍaḥ । nirvāṇadhūmākularājayaś ca । nīlotpalābhāḥ pracakāśire 'bhrāḥ ॥34॥
vajrī mahendras tridaśeśvaro vā । sākṣād yamo vā varuṇo 'nilo vā । rudro 'gnir arko dhanadaś ca somo । na vānaro 'yaṃ svayameva kālaḥ ॥35॥
kiṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvapitāmahasya । lokasya dhātuś caturānanasya । ihāgato vānararūpadhārī । rakṣopasaṃhārakaraḥ prakopaḥ ॥36॥
kiṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vā kapirūpam etya । rakṣovināśāya paraṃ sutejaḥ । acintyam avyaktam anantam ekaṃ । svamāyayā sāmpratam āgataṃ vā ॥37॥
ity evam ūcur bahavo viśiṣṭā । rakṣogaṇās tatra sametya sarve । saprāṇisaṃghāṃ sagṛhāṃ savṛkṣāṃ । dagdhāṃ purīṃ tāṃ sahasā samīkṣya ॥38॥
tatas tu laṅkā sahasā pradagdhā । sarākṣasā sāśvarathā sanāgā । sapakṣisaṃghā samṛgā savṛkṣā । ruroda dīnā tumulaṃ saśabdam ॥39॥
hā tāta hā putraka kānta mitra । hā jīviteśāṅga hataṃ supuṇyam । rakṣobhir evaṃ bahudhā bruvadbhiḥ । śabdaḥ kṛto ghorataraḥ subhīmaḥ ॥40॥
bhaṅktvā vanaṃ pādaparatnasaṃkulaṃ । hatvā tu rakṣāṃsi mahānti saṃyuge । dagdhvā purīṃ tāṃ gṛharatnamālinīṃ । tasthau hanūmān pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ ॥43॥
tatas tu taṃ vānaravīramukhyaṃ । mahābalaṃ mārutatulyavegam । mahāmatiṃ vāyusutaṃ variṣṭhaṃ । pratuṣṭuvur devagaṇāś ca sarve ॥45॥
devāś ca sarve munipuṃgavāś ca । gandharvavidhyādharapannagāś ca । bhūtāni sarvāṇi mahanti tatra । jagmuḥ parāṃ prītim atulyarūpām ॥46॥
bhaṅktvā vanaṃ mahātejā hatvā rakṣāṃsi saṃyuge । dagdhvā laṅkāpurīṃ bhīmāṃ rarāja sa mahākapiḥ ॥47॥
gṛhāgryaśṛṅgāgratale vicitre । pratiṣṭhito vānararājasiṃhaḥ । pradīptalāṅgūlakṛtārcimālī । vyarājatāditya ivāṃśumālī ॥48॥
tato dēvāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ । dṛṣṭvā laṅkāṃ pradagdhāṃ tāṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ॥50॥
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vānaraśrēṣṭhaṃ hanumantaṃ mahākapim । kālāgnir iti saṃcintya sarvabhūtāni tatrasuḥ ॥51॥
kruddhaḥ pāpaṃ na kuryāt kaḥ kruddho hanyād gurūn api । kruddhaḥ paruṣayā vācā naraḥ sādhūn adhikṣipet ॥4॥
vācyāvācyaṃ prakupito na vijānāti karhicit । nākāryamasti kruddhasya nāvācyaṃ vidyate kvacit ॥5॥
yaḥ samutpatitaṃ krodhaṃ kṣamayaiva nirasyati । yathoragas tvacaṃ jīrṇāṃ sa vai puruṣa ucyate ॥6॥
dhig astu māṃ sudurbuddhiṃ nirlajjaṃ pāpakṛttamam । acintayitvā tāṃ sītām agnidaṃ svāmighātakam ॥7॥
punaś cācintayat tatra hanumān vismitas tadā । hiraṇyanābhasya girer jalamadhye pradarśanam ॥27॥
prapalāyitarakṣaḥstrībālavṛddhasamākulā । janakolāhalādhmātā krandantīvādrikandaraiḥ ॥31॥
iti śuśrāva hanuman vācaṃ tām amṛtopamām । babhūva cāsya manaso harṣastatkālasambhavaḥ ॥33॥
yadi tvaṃ manyase tāta vasaikāhamihānagha । kvacit susaṃvṛte deśe viśrantaḥ śvo gamiṣyasi ॥3॥
mama caivālpabhagyāyāḥ saṃnidhyāt tava vānara । śokasyāsyāprameyasya muhūrtaṃ syād api kṣayaḥ ॥4॥
gate hi hariśardūla punaḥ samprāptaye tvayi । praṇeṣvāpi na viśvāso mama vānarapuṃgava ॥5॥
adarśanaṃ ca te vīra bhūyo māṃ dārāyiṣyati । duḥkhād dyḥkhataraṃ prāptāṃ durmanaśśokakarśitām ॥6॥
ayaṃ ca vīra saṃdehas tiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ । sumahatsu sahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu mahābalaḥ ॥7॥
kathaṃ nu khalu duṣpāraṃ saṃtariṣyati sāgaram । tāni haryṛkṣasainyāni tau vā naravarātmajau ॥8॥
trayāṇāṃ eva bhūtānāṃ sāgarasyāpi laṅghane । śaktiḥ syād vainateyasya tava vā marutasya vā ॥9॥
tad atra kāryanirbandhe samutpanne dūrāsade । kiṃ paśyasi samādhānaṃ tvaṃ hi kāryaviśāradaḥ ॥10॥
devi haryṛkṣasainyānām īśvaraḥ plavatām varaḥ । sugrīvaḥ sattvasampannas tavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ ॥15॥
sa vānarasahasrāṇāṃ koṭibhir abhisaṃvṛtaḥ । kṣipram eṣyati vaidehi sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ ॥16॥
tau ca vīrau naravarau sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau । āgamya nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ sāyakair vidhamiṣyataḥ ॥17॥
sagaṇaṃ rakṣasaṃ hatvā nacirād raghunandanaḥ । tvām ādāya varārohe svāṃ purīṃ prati yasyati ॥18॥
samaśvasihi bhadraṃ te bhava tvaṃ kālakaṅkṣinī । kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāmeṇa nihataṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe ॥19॥
nihate rākṣasendre ca saputrāmatyabandhave । tvaṃ sameṣyasi rāmeṇa śaśaṅkeneva rohiṇī ॥20॥
rākṣasān pravarān hatvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ । samāśvāsya ca vaidehiṃ darśayitvā paraṃ balam ॥23॥
nagarīm ākulāṃ kṛtvā vañcaitvā ca rāvaṇam । darśaitvā balaṃ ghoraṃ vaidehīm abhivādya ca ॥24॥
pratigantuṃ manaścakre punar adhyena sāgaram । tataḥ sa kapiśārdūlaḥ svāmisaṃdarśanotsukaḥ ॥25॥
āruroha giriśreṣṭham ariṣṭam arimardanaḥ । tuṅgapadmakajuṣṭābhir nīlābhir vanarājibhiḥ ॥26॥
sottarīyam ivāmbhodaiḥ śṛṅgāntaravilambibhiḥ । bodhyamānam iva prītyā divākarakair śubhaiḥ ॥27॥
unmiṣantam ivoddhūtair locanair iva dhātubhiḥ । toyaughaniḥsvanair mandraiḥ prādhītam iva parvatam ॥28॥
pragītam iva vispaṣṭam nānāprasravaṇasvanaiḥ । devadārubhir uddhūtair ūrdhvabāhumiva sthitam ॥29॥
prapātajalanirghoṣair prākṛuṣṭam iva sarvataḥ । vepamānam iva śyāmaiḥ kampamānaiḥ śaradvanaiḥ ॥30॥
veṇubhir mārutoddhūtaiḥ kūjantam iva kīcakaiḥ । niḥśvasantam ivāmarṣād ghorair āśīviṣottamaiḥ ॥31॥
nīhārakṛtagambhīrair dhyāyantam iva gahvaraiḥ । meghapādanibhaiḥ pādaiḥ prakrāntamiva sarvataḥ ॥32॥
jṛmbhamāṇam ivākāśe śikharair abhrāmālibhiḥ । kūṭaiś ca bahudhā kīrṇaṃ śobhitam bahukandaraiḥ ॥33॥
sālatālaiś ca karṇaiś ca vaṃśaiś ca bahubhir vṛtam । latāvitānair vitataiḥ puṣpavadbhir alaṃkṛtam ॥34॥
nānāmṛgagaṇaiḥ kīrṇaṃ dhātuniṣyandabhūṣitam । bahuprasravaṇopetaṃ śilāsaṃcayasaṃkaṭam ॥35॥
maharṣiyakṣagandharvakiṃnaroragasevitam । latāpādapasaṃbādhaṃ siṃhādhiṣṭhitakandaram ॥36॥
vyāghrādibhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ svādumūlaphaladrumam । ārurohānilasutaḥ parvataṃ plavagottamaḥ ॥37॥
rāmadarśanaśīghreṇa praharṣeṇābhicoditaḥ । tena pādatalākrāntā ramyeṣu girisānuṣu ॥38॥
saghoṣāḥ samaśīryanta śilāś cūrṇīkṛtās tataḥ । sa tam āruhya śailendraṃ vyavardhata mahākapiḥ ॥39॥
dakṣiṇād uttaraṃ pāraṃ prārthayaṃl lavaṇāmbhasaḥ । adhiruhya tato vīraḥ parvataṃ pavanātmajaḥ ॥40॥
dadarśa sāgaraṃ bhīmaṃ bhīmoraganiṣevitam । sa māruta ivākāśaṃ mārutasyātmasaṃbhavaḥ ॥41॥
prapede hariśārdūlo dakṣiṇād uttarāṃ diśam । sa tadā pīḍitas tena kapinā parvatottamaḥ ॥42॥
rarāsa vividhair bhūtaiḥ prāviśad vasudhātalam । kampamānaiś ca śikharaiḥ patadbhir api ca drumaiḥ ॥43॥
sa lilaṅghayiṣur bhīmam salīlam lavaṇārṇavam । kallolāsphālavelāntam utpapāta nabho hariḥ ॥51॥
vividhābhraghanāpannagocaro dhavalāmbaraḥ । dṛśyādṛśyatanur vīras tathā candrāyate 'mbare ॥9॥
tārkṣyāyamāno gagane sa babhau vāyunandanaḥ । dārayan meghavṛndāni niṣpataṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥10॥
nadan nādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ । pravarān rākṣasān hatvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ ॥11॥
ākulāṃ nagarīṃ krṭvā vyathayitvā ca rāvaṇam । ardayitvā mahāvīrān vaidehim abhivādya ca ॥12॥
ājagāma mahātejāḥ punar madhyena sāgaram । parvatendraṃ sunābhaṃ ca samupaspṛśya vīryavān ॥13॥
jyāmukta iva nārāco mahāvego 'bhyupāgamat । sa kiṃ cid ārāt saṃprāptaḥ samālokya mahāgirim ॥14॥
mahendraṃ meghasaṃkāśaṃ nanāda sa mahākapiḥ । sa pūrayām āsa kapir diśo daśa samantataḥ ॥15॥
nanāda sumahānādaṃ lāṅgūlam cāpyakampayat । tasya nānadyamānasya suparṇacarite pathi ॥17॥
phalatīvāsya ghoṣeṇa gaganam sārkamaṇḍalam । ye tu tatrottare kūle samudrasya mahābalāḥ ॥18॥
pūrvam samviṣṭhitāḥ śūrā vāyuputradidṛkṣavaḥ । mahato vāyununnasya toyadasyeva niḥsvanam । śuśruvus te tadā ghoṣamūruvegam hanūmataḥ ॥19॥
te dīnamanasaḥ sarve śuśruvuḥ kānanaukasaḥ । vānarendrasya nirghoṣam parjanyaninadopamam ॥20॥
girigahvarasamlīno yathā garjati mārutaḥ । evam jagarja balavān hanūmān mārutātamajaḥ ॥27॥
harṣeṇāpūryamāṇo 'asau ramye parvatanirjhare । cinnapakṣa ivākāśāt papāta dharaṇīdharaḥ ॥30॥
upavāsapariśrāntā malinā jaṭilā kṛśā । tato dṛṣṭeti vacanaṃ mahārtham amṛtopamam ॥40॥
niśamya māruteḥ sarve muditā vānarābhavan । kṣveḍanty anye nadanty anye garjanty anye mahābalāḥ ॥41॥
cakruḥ kilakilām anye pratigarjanti cāpare । ke cid ucchritalāṅgūlāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapikuñjarāḥ ॥42॥
āyatāñcitadīrghāṇi lāṅgūlāni pravivyadhuḥ । apare tu hanūmantaṃ śrīmantaṃ vānarottamam ॥43॥
āplutya giriśṛṅgeṣu saṃspṛśanti sma harṣitāḥ । uktavākyaṃ hanūmantam aṅgadas tu tadābravīt ॥44॥
sarveṣāṃ harivīrāṇāṃ madhye vācam anuttamām । sattve vīrye na te kaś cit samo vānara vidyate ॥45॥
yad avaplutya vistīrṇaṃ sāgaraṃ punar āgataḥ । jīvitasya pradātā nas tvam eko vānarottama ॥46॥
tvatprasādāt sameṣyāmaḥ siddhārthā raghaveṇa ha । aho svāmini te bhaktir aho vīryam aho dhṛtiḥ ॥47॥
upāviṣṭā gires tasya silāsu vipulāsu te । śrotukāmāḥ samudrasya laṅghanaṃ vānarottamāḥ ॥50॥
darśanaṃ cāpi laṅkāyāḥ sītāyā rāvaṇasya ca । tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve hanūmad vadanonmukhāḥ ॥51॥
prītimatsūpaviṣṭeṣu vānareṣu mahātmasu । taṃ tataḥ pratisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ prītiyuktaṃ mahākapim ॥2॥
jāmbavān kāryavṛttāntam apṛcchad anilātmajam । kathaṃ dṛṣṭā tvayā devī kathaṃ vā tatra vartate ॥3॥
tasyāṃ cāpi kathaṃ vṛttaḥ krūrakarmā daśānanaḥ । tattvataḥ sarvam etan naḥ prabrūhi tvaṃ mahākape ॥4॥
kṛtā me manasā buddhir bhettavyo 'yaṃ mayeti ca । prahatasya mayā tasya lāṅgūlena mahāgireḥ ॥11॥
śikharaṃ sūryasaṃkāśaṃ vyaśīryata sahasradhā । vyavasāyaṃ ca me buddhvā sa hovāca mahāgiriḥ ॥12॥
putreti madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ manaḥ prahlādayann iva । pitṛvyaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sakhāyaṃ mātariśvanaḥ ॥13॥
mainākam iti vikhyātaṃ nivasantaṃ mahodadhau । pakṣvavantaḥ purā putra babhūvuḥ parvatottamāḥ ॥14॥
chandataḥ pṛthivīṃ cerur bādhamānāḥ samantataḥ । śrutvā nagānāṃ caritaṃ mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ॥15॥
vajreṇa bhagavān pakṣau cicchedaiṣāṃ sahasraśaḥ । ahaṃ tu mokṣitas tasmāt tava pitrā mahātmanā ॥16॥
mārutena tadā vatsa prakṣipto vāruṇālaye । rāghavasya mayā sāhye vartitavyam ariṃdama ॥17॥
rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭho mahendrasamavikramaḥ । etac chrutvā mayā tasya mainākasya mahātmanaḥ ॥18॥
kāryam āvedya ca girer uddhataṃ vai mano mama । tena cāham anujñāto mainākena mahātmanā ॥19॥
sa cāpyantarhitaḥ śailo mānuṣeṇa vapuṣmatā । śarīreṇa mahāśailaḥ śailena ca mahodadhau ॥20॥
uttamaṃ javam āsthāya śeṣam adhvānam āsthitaḥ । tato 'haṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ vegenābhyagamaṃ pathi ॥21॥
tataḥ paśyāmy ahaṃ devīṃ surasāṃ nāgamātaram । samudramadhye sā devī vacanaṃ cedam abravīt ॥22॥
mama bhakṣyaḥ pradiṣṭas tvam amārair harisattama । tatas tvāṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi vihitas tvaṃ hi me suraiḥ ॥23॥
āgamiṣyāmi te vaktraṃ satyaṃ pratiśṛṇomi te । evam uktā mayā sā tu surasā kāmarūpiṇī ॥28॥
abravīn nātivarteta kaś cid eṣa varo mama । evam uktaḥ surasayā daśayojanam āyataḥ ॥29॥
tato 'rdhaguṇavistāro babhūvāhaṃ kṣaṇena tu । matpramāṇādhikaṃ caiva vyāditaṃ tu mukhaṃ tayā ॥30॥
tad dṛṣṭvā vyāditaṃ tv āsyaṃ hrasvaṃ hy akaravaṃ vapuḥ । tasmin muhūrte ca punar babhūvāṅguṣṭhasaṃmitaḥ ॥31॥
abhipatyāśu tad vaktraṃ nirgato 'haṃ tataḥ kṣaṇāt । abravīt surasā devī svena rūpeṇa māṃ punaḥ ॥32॥
arthasiddhyai hariśreṣṭha gaccha saumya yathāsukham । samānaya ca vaidehīṃ rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ॥33॥
sukhī bhava mahābāho prītāsmi tava vānara । tato 'haṃ sādhu sādhvīti sarvabhūtaiḥ praśaṃsitaḥ ॥34॥
tato 'ntarikṣaṃ vipulaṃ pluto 'haṃ garuḍo yathā । chāyā me nigṛhītā ca na ca paśyāmi kiṃ cana ॥35॥
so 'haṃ vigatavegas tu diśo daśa vilokayan । na kiṃ cit tatra paśyāmi yena me vihatā gatiḥ ॥36॥
dakṣiṇaṃ tīram udadher laṅkā yatra ca sā purī । astaṃ dinakare yāte rakṣasāṃ nilayaṃ purīm ॥47॥
praviṣṭo 'ham avijñāto rakṣobhir bhīmavikramaiḥ । tatrāhaṃ praviśataś cāpi kalpāntaghanasaprabhā ॥48॥
aṭṭahāsam vimuñcantī nārī kāpyutthitā puraḥ । jighāṃsantīm tatas tām tu jvaladagniśiroruhām ॥49॥
savyamuṣṭiprahāreṇa parājitya subhairavām । pradoṣakāle praviśam bhītayāham tayoditaḥ ॥50॥
aham laṅkāpurī vīra nirjitā vikrameṇa te । yasmāt tasmād vijetāsi sarvarakṣāṃsyaśeṣataḥ ॥51॥
tam āruhya ca paśyāmi kāñcanaṃ kadalīvanam । adūrāc chiṃśapāvṛkṣāt paśyāmi varavarṇinīm ॥56॥
śyāmāṃ kamalapatrākṣīm upavāsakṛśānanām । tadekavāsassavītām rajodhvastaśiroruhām ॥57॥
śokasaṃtāpadīnāṅgīm sītām bhartṛhite sthitām । rākṣasībhir virūpābhiḥ krūrābhir abhisaṃvṛtām ॥58॥
māṃsaśoṇitabhakṣyābhir vyāghrībhir hariṇīṃ yathā । sā mayā rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmahuḥ ॥59॥
ekaveṇīdharā dīnā bhartṛcintāparāyaṇā । bhūmiśayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himāgame ॥60॥
rāvaṇād vinivṛttārthā martavye kṛtaniścayā । kathaṃcin mṛgaśāvākṣī tūrṇam āsāditā mayā ॥61॥
vitrastām paramodvignām vīkṣamāṇām itas tataḥ । trāṇam kiṃcid apaśyantīm vepamānām tapasvinīm ॥67॥
avācyaṃ vadato jihvā kathaṃ na patitā tava । kiṃsvid vīryaṃ tavānārya yo māṃ bhartur asaṃnidhau ॥72॥
apahṛtyāgataḥ pāpa tenādṛṣṭo mahātmanā । na tvaṃ rāmasya sadṛśo dāsye 'py asyā na yujyase ॥73॥
ajeyaḥ satyavāk śūro raṇaślāghī ca rāghavaḥ । jānakyā paruṣaṃ vākyam evam ukto daśānanaḥ ॥74॥
jajvāla sahasā kopāc citāstha iva pāvakaḥ । vivṛtya nayane krūre muṣṭim udyamya dakṣiṇam ॥75॥
maithilīm hantum ārabdhaḥ strībhiḥ hāhā kṛtam tadā । strīṇām madhyāt samutpatya tasya bhāryā durātmanaḥ ॥76॥
varā mandodarī nāma tayā sa pratiṣedhitaḥ । uktaś ca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ tayā sa madanārditaḥ ॥77॥
sītayā tava kiṃ kāryaṃ mahendrasamavikrama । mayā saha ramasvādya madviśiṣṭā na jānakī ॥78॥
tāsām madhyāt samutthāya trijaṭā vākyamabravīt । ātmānam khādata kṣipram na sītām asitekṣaṇām ॥86॥
janakasyātmajāṃ sādhvīṃ snuṣāṃ daśarathasya ca । svapno hyadya mayā dṛṣṭo dāruṇo romaharṣaṇaḥ ॥87॥
rakṣasām ca vināśāya bharturasyā jayāya ca । alam asmāt paritrātum rāghavād rakṣasīgaṇam ॥88॥
abhiyācāma vaidehīm etaddhi mama rocate । yadi hy evamvidhaḥ svapno duḥkhitāyāḥ pradṛśyate ॥89॥
sā duḥkhair vividhair muktā sukham āpnoty anuttamam । praṇipātaprasannā hi maithilī janakātmajā ॥90॥
alam eṣā paritrātuṃ rākṣasyo mahato bhayāt । tatah sā hrīmatī bālā bharturvijayaharṣitā ॥91॥
avocad yadi tat tathyaṃ bhaveyaṃ śaraṇaṃ hi vaḥ । tāṃ cāhaṃ tādṛśīṃ dṛṣṭvā sītāyā dāruṇāṃ daśām ॥92॥
cintayām āsa viśrānto na ca me nirvṛtaṃ manaḥ । sambhāṣaṇārthe ca mayā jānakyāś cintito vidhiḥ ॥93॥
ikṣvākukulavaṃśas tu stuto mama puraskṛtaḥ । śrutvā tu gaditāṃ vācaṃ rājarṣigaṇapūjitām ॥94॥
pratyabhāṣata māṃ devī bāṣpaiḥ pihitalocanā । kas tvaṃ kena kathaṃ ceha prāpto vānarapuṃgava ॥95॥
kā ca rāmeṇa te prītis tan me śaṃsitum arhasi । tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā aham apy abruvaṃ vacaḥ ॥96॥
devi rāmasya bhartus te sahāyo bhīmavikramaḥ । sugrīvo nāma vikrānto vānarendo mahābalaḥ ॥97॥
atha mām abravīt sītā gṛhyatām ayam uttamaḥ । maṇir yena mahābāhū rāmas tvāṃ bahu manyate ॥103॥
rākṣasair bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ ghorarūpair bhayānakaiḥ । tam ahaṃ balasaṃpannaṃ rākṣasaṃ raṇakovidam ॥120॥
parigheṇātighoreṇa sūdayāmi sahānugam । tac chrutvā rākṣasendras tu mantriputrān mahābalān ॥121॥
padātibalasaṃpannān preṣayām āsa rāvaṇaḥ । parigheṇaiva tān sarvān nayāmi yamasādanam ॥122॥
tān ahaṃ saha sainyān vai sarvān evābhyasūdayam । tataḥ punar daśagrīvaḥ putram akṣaṃ mahābalam ॥124॥
bahubhī rākasaiḥ sārdhaṃ preṣayām āsa saṃyuge । taṃ tu mandodarīputraṃ kumāraṃ raṇapaṇḍitam ॥125॥
sahasā khaṃ samudyantaṃ pādayoś ca gṛhītavān । tam āsīnaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhrāmayitvā vyapeṣayam ॥126॥
vyādideśa susaṃkruddho balinaṃ yuddhadurmadam । tac cāpyahaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ taṃ ca rākṣasapuṃgavam ॥128॥
naṣṭaujasaṃ raṇe kṛtvā paraṃ harṣam upāgataḥ । mahatāpi mahābāhuḥ pratyayena mahābalaḥ ॥129॥
preṣito rāvaṇenaiṣa saha vīrair madodhataiḥ । so 'viṣahyam hi mām buddhvā svasainyaṃ cāvamarditam ॥130॥
sugrīvaśca mahābhāgaḥ sa tvām kuśalam abravīt । dharmārthakāmasahitaṃ hitaṃ pathyam uvāca ha ॥137॥
naivaṃ rākṣasaśardūla tyajyatām eṣa niścayaḥ । rājaśāstravyapeto hi mārgaḥ saṃlakṣyate tvayā ॥148॥
vinaṣṭā jānakī vyaktaṃ na hy adagdhaḥ pradṛśyate । laṅkāyāḥ kaścid uddeśaḥ sarvā bhasmīkṛtā purī ॥159॥
dahatā ca mayā laṅkāṃ daghdā sītā na saṃśayaḥ । rāmasya ca mahākāryaṃ mayedaṃ vikalīkṛtam ॥160॥
iti śokasamāviṣṭaś cintām aham upāgataḥ । tato 'haṃ vācam aśrauṣaṃ cāraṇānāṃ śubhākṣarām ॥161॥
jānakī na ca dagdheti vismayodantabhāṣiṇām । tato me buddhir utpannā śrutvā tām adbhutāṃ giram ॥162॥
adagdhā jānakīty evaṃ nimittaiś copalakṣitam । dīpyamāne tu lāṅgūle na māṃ dahati pāvakaḥ ॥163॥
hṛdayaṃ ca prahṛṣṭaṃ me vātāḥ surabhigandhinaḥ । tair nimittaiś ca dṛṣṭārthaiḥ kāraṇaiś ca mahāguṇaiḥ ॥164॥
tataḥ parvatam āsādya tatrāriṣtamaham punaḥ । pratiplavanamārebhe yuṣmaddarśanakāṃkṣayā ॥166॥
tataḥ svasanacandrārkasiddhagandharvasevitam । panthānam aham ākramya bhavato dṛṣṭavān iha ॥167॥
jāmbavatpramukhān sarvān anujñāpya mahākapīn । asminnevaṃgate kārye bhavatām ca nivedite । nyāyyam sma saha vaidehyā draṣṭum tau pārthivātmajau ॥6॥
aham eko’pi paryāptaḥ sarākṣasagaṇāṃ purīm । tāṃ laṅkāṃ tarasā hantuṃ rāvaṇaṃ ca mahābalam ॥7॥
kim punaḥ sahito vīrair balavadbhiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ । kṛtāstraiḥ plavagaiḥ śaktair bhavadbhir vijayaiṣibhiḥ ॥8॥
ahaṃ tu rāvaṇaṃ yuddhe sasainyaṃ sapuraḥsaram । sahaputraṃ vadhiṣyāmi sahodarayutaṃ yudhi ॥9॥
brāhmamastraṃ ca raudraṃ ca vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā । yadi śakrajito’astraṇi durnirīkṣyāṇi samyuge । tāny ahaṃ nihaniṣyāmi vidhamiṣyāmi ca rākṣasān ॥10॥
bhavatām abhyanujñāto vikramo me ruṇaddhi tam । mayātulā visṛṣṭā hi śailavṛṣṭirnirantarā ॥11॥
devān api raṇe hanyāt kiṃ punas tān niśācarān । bhavatām ananujñāto vikramo me ruṇaddhi mām ॥12॥
sāgaro ‘apy atiyād velām mandaraḥ pracaled api । na jāmbavantaṃ samare kampayed arivāhinī ॥13॥
sarvarākṣasasamghānām rākṣasā ye ca pūrvajāḥ । alam eko ‘pi nāśāya vīro vālisutaḥ kapiḥ ॥14॥
plavagasyoruvegena nīlasya ca mahātmanaḥ । mandaro ‘apy avaśīryeta kiṃ punar yudhi rākṣasāḥ ॥15॥
sadevāsurayakṣeṣu gandharvoragapakṣiṣu । maindasya pratiyoddhāraṃ śaṃsata dvividasya vā ॥16॥
aśviputrau mahāvegāvetau plavagasattamau । etayoḥ pratiyoddhāraṃ na paśyāmi raṇājire ॥17॥
mayaiva nihatā laṅkā dagdhā bhasmīkṛtā purī । rājamārgeṣu sarveṣu nāma viśrāvitaṃ mayā ॥18॥
jayaty atibalo rāmo lakṣmaṇaś ca mahābalaḥ । rājā jayati sugrīvo rāghaveṇābhipālitaḥ ॥19॥
ahaṃ kosalarājasya dāsaḥ pavanasambhavaḥ । hanumān iti sarvatra nāma viśrāvitam mayā ॥20॥
rākṣasībhir virūpābhir dṛṣṭā hi pramadā vane । ekaveṇīdharā dīnā bhartṛcintāparāyaṇā ॥26॥
adhaḥśayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himodaye । rāvaṇād vinivṛttārthā martavyakṛtaniścayā ॥27॥
kathaṃ cin mṛgaśāvākṣī viśvāsam upapāditā । tataḥ sambhāṣitā caiva sarvam arthaṃ prakāśitā ॥28॥
sā prakṛtyaiva tanvaṅgī tadviyogāc ca karśitā । pratipatpāṭhaśīlasya vidyeva tanutām gatā ॥31॥
pitāmahavarotsekāt paramaṃ darpam āsthitau । aśvinor mānanārthaṃ hi sarvalokapitāmahaḥ ॥2॥
sarvāvadhyatvam atulam anayor dattavān purā । varotsekena mattau ca pramathya mahatīṃ camūm ॥3॥
surāṇām amṛtaṃ vīrau pītavantau mahābalau । etāv eva hi saṃkruddhau savājirathakuñjarām ॥4॥
laṅkāṃ nāśayituṃ śaktau sarve tiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ । aham eko 'pi paryāptaḥ sarākṣasagaṇāṃ purīm ॥5॥
tāṃ laṅkāṃ tarasā hantuṃ rāvaṇaṃ ca mahābalam । kiṃ punaḥ sahito vīrair balavadbhiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ॥6॥
kṛtāstraiḥ plavagaiḥ śaktair bhavadbhir vijayaiṣibhiḥ । vāyusūnor balenaiva daghdhā laṅketi naḥ śrutam ॥7॥
jitvā laṅkāṃ sarakṣaudghāṃ hatvā taṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe । sītam adāya gacchāmaḥ siddhārthā hṛṣṭamanasāḥ ॥10॥
rāmalakṣmaṇayor madhye nyasyāma janakātmajām । kiṃ vyalīkais tu tān sarvān vānarān vānaraṛsabhān ॥12॥
vayam eva hi gatvā tān hatvā rakṣasapuṃgavān । raghavaṃ draṣṭum arhāmaḥ sugrīvaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam ॥13॥
naiṣā buddhir mahābuddhe yad bravīṣi mahākape । vicetuṃ vayam ājñaptā dakṣiṇāṃ diśām uttamām ॥15॥
nānetuṃ kapirājena naiva rāmeṇa dhīmatā । kathaṃcin nirjitāṃ sītām asmābhir nābhirocayet ॥16॥
rāghavo nṛpaśardūlaḥ kūlaṃ vyapadiśan svakam । pratijñāya svayaṃ rājā sītāvijayamagrataḥ ॥17॥
sarveṣu kapimukyānāṃ kathaṃ mithyā kariṣyati । viphalaṃ karma ca kṛtaṃ bhavet tuṣṭir na tasya ca ॥18॥
vṛthā ca darśitaṃ vīryaṃ bhaved vānarapuṃgavāḥ । tasmād gacchāma vai sarve yatra rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ । sugrīvaś ca mahatejāḥ kāryasyāsya nivedane ॥19॥
te niḥsṛṣṭāḥ kumāreṇa dhīmatā valisūnunā । harayaḥ samapadyanta drumān madhukarākulān ॥13॥
bhakṣyantaḥ sugandhīni mulāni ca phalāni ca । jagmuḥ praharṣaṃ te sarve babhuvuś ca madotkaṭāḥ ॥14॥
tudantam anyaḥ praṇadann upaiti । samākulaṃ tat kapisainyam āsīt । na cātra kaś cin na babhūva matto । na cātra kaś cin na babhūva tṛptaḥ ॥19॥
ahamāvārayiṣyāmi yuṣmākam paripanthinaḥ । śrutvā hanumato vākyaṃ harīṇāṃ pravaro 'ṅgadaḥ ॥2॥
pratyuvāca prasannātmā pibantu harayo madhu । avaśyaṃ kṛtakāryasya vākyaṃ hanumato mayā ॥3॥
akāryam api kartavyaṃ kim aṅgaṃ punar īdṛśam । andagasya mukhāc chrutvā vacanaṃ vānararṣabhāḥ ॥4॥
sādhu sādhv iti saṃhṛṣṭā vānarāḥ pratyapūjayan । pūjayitvāṅgadaṃ sarve vānarā vānararṣabham ॥5॥
jagmur madhuvanaṃ yatra nadīvega iva drumam । te praviṣṭā madhuvanaṃ pālān ākramya śaktitaḥ ॥6॥
atisargāc ca paṭavo dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca maithilīm । papuḥ sarve madhu tadā rasavat phalam ādaduḥ ॥7॥
ghnanti sma sahitāḥ sarve bhakṣayanti tathāpare । ke cit pītvāpavidhyanti madhūni madhupiṅgalāḥ ॥10॥
madhūcchiṣṭena ke cic ca jaghnur anyonyam utkaṭāḥ । apare vṛkṣamūleṣu śākhā gṛhya vyavasthitaḥ ॥11॥
atyarthaṃ ca madaglānāḥ parṇāny āstīrya śerate । unmattavegāḥ plavagā madhumattāś ca hṛṣṭavat ॥12॥
kṣipanty api tathānyonyaṃ skhalanty api tathāpare । ke cit kṣveḍān prakurvanti ke cit kūjanti hṛṣṭavat ॥13॥
harayo madhunā mattāḥ ke cit suptā mahītale । dhṛṣṭā kecid dhasanty anye kecit kurvanti cetarat ॥14॥
kṛtvā kecid vadanty anyat kecid budhyanti cetarat । ye 'py atra madhupālāḥ syuḥ preṣyā dadhimukhasya tu ॥15॥
te 'pi tair vānarair bhīmaiḥ pratiṣiddhā diśo gatāḥ । jānubhiś ca praghṛṣṭāś ca devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ ॥16॥
balānnivārayantaśca āsedur harayo harīn । saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭāḥ kruddhā bhartsayanto muhur muhuḥ ॥23॥
kiṃ sambhramād dhitam kṛtsnaṃ brūhi yad vaktum arhasi । kaccin madhuvane svasti śrotum icchāmi vānara ॥3॥
nyavārayam ahaṃ sarvān sahaibhir vanacāribhiḥ । acintayitvā māṃ hṛṣṭā bhakṣyanti pibanti ca ॥6॥
vārayanto bhṛśaṃ prāptaḥ pālā jānubhir āhataḥ । tathā na gaṇitaś cāyaṃ kapir dadhimukho balī ॥18॥
patir mama vanasyāyam asmābhiḥ sthāpitaḥ svayam । dṛṣṭā devī na saṃdeho na cānyena hanūmatā ॥19॥
na hy anyaḥ sādhane hetuḥ karmaṇo 'sya hanūmataḥ । kāryasiddhir hanumati matiś ca haripuṃgave ॥20॥
vyavasāyaś ca vīryaṃ ca śrutaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam । jāmbavān yatra netā syād aṅgadaśca mahābalaḥ ॥21॥
hanūmāṃś cāpy adhiṣṭhātā na tatra gatir anyathā । aṅgadapramukhair vīrair hataṃ madhuvanaṃ kila ॥22॥
vicintya dakṣiṇām āśām āgatair haripuṃgavaiḥ । āgataiś cāpradhṛṣyaṃ tad dhataṃ madhuvanaṃ hi taiḥ ॥23॥
dharṣitaṃ ca vanaṃ kṛtsnam upayuktaṃ ca vānaraiḥ । pātitā vanapālās te tadā jānubhir āhatāḥ ॥24॥
vanapālaṃ punar vākyaṃ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata । prīto 'smi so ‘ham yad bhuktaṃ vanaṃ taiḥ kṛtakarmabhiḥ ॥30॥
dharṣitaṃ marṣaṇīyaṃ ca ceṣṭitaṃ kṛtakarmaṇām । gaccha śīghraṃ madhuvanaṃ saṃrakṣasva tvam eva hi । śīghraṃ preśaya sarvaṃs tān hanumatpramukhān kapīn ॥31॥
prītisphītākṣau samprahṛṣṭau kumārau । dṛṣṭvā siddhārthau vānarāṇāṃ ca rājā । aṅgaiḥ prahṛṣṭaiḥ kāryasiddhiṃ viditvā । bāhvorāsannām atimātraṃ nananda ॥33॥
śrānto dūrādanuprāpto bhakṣyasva svakaṃ madhu । yuvarājas tvam īśaś ca vanasyāsya mahābala ॥7॥
maurkhyāt pūrvaṃ kṛto roṣas tad bhavān kṣantum arhati । yathaiva hi pitā te 'bhūt pūrvaṃ harigaṇeśvaraḥ ॥8॥
tathā tvam api sugrīvo nānyas tu harisattama । ākhyātaṃ hi mayā gatvā pitṛvyasya tavānagha ॥9॥
ihopayānaṃ sarveṣām eteṣāṃ vanacāriṇām । bhavadāgamanaṃ śrutvā sahaibhir vanacāribhiḥ ॥10॥
prahṛṣṭo na tu ruṣṭo 'sau vanaṃ śrutvā pradharṣitam । prahṛṣṭo māṃ pitṛvyas te sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ ॥11॥
śīghraṃ preṣaya sarvāṃs tān iti hovāca pārthivaḥ । śrutvā dadhimukhasyaitad vacanaṃ ślakṣṇam aṅgadaḥ ॥12॥
abravīt tān hariśreṣṭho vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ । śaṅke śruto 'yaṃ vṛttānto rāmeṇa hariyūthapāḥ ॥13॥
aṅgadaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā hanumantaṃ ca vānaram । te 'mbaraṃ sahasotpatya vegavantaḥ plavaṃgamāḥ ॥25॥
vinadanto mahānādaṃ ghanā vāteritā yathā । aṅgade samanuprāpte sugrīvo vānareṣvaraḥ ॥26॥
uvāca śokasaṃtaptaṃ rāmaṃ kamalalocanam । samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te dṛṣṭā devī na saṃśayaḥ ॥27॥
nāgantum iha śakyaṃ tair atitasamayair iha । aṅgadasya praharṣāc ca jānāmi śubhadarśana ॥28॥
na hy anyaḥ karmaṇo hetuḥ sādhane ‘sya hanūmataḥ । hanūmatīha siddhiś ca matiś ca matisattama ॥33॥
vyavasāyaś ca śauryaṃ ca śrūtaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam । jāmbavān yatra netā syād aṅgadaś ca harīśvaraḥ ॥34॥
yadā hi darpitodagrāḥ saṃgatāḥ kānanaukasaḥ । naiṣām akṛtakaryāṇām īdṛśaḥ syād upakramaḥ ॥36॥
vanabhaṅgena jānāmi madhūnāṃ bhakṣnena ca । tataḥ kilakilā śabdaṃ śuśrāvāsannam ambare ॥37॥
hanūmatkarmadṛptānāṃ nardatāṃ kānanaukasām । kiṣkindhām upayātānāṃ siddhiṃ kathayatām iva ॥38॥
dṛṣṭā devīti hanūmadvadanād amṛtopamam । ākarṇya vacanaṃ rāmo harṣamāpa lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥43॥
uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ sītāyā darśanaṃ yathā । taṃ maṇiṃ kāñcanaṃ divyaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā ॥8॥
tattvā rāmāya hanūmaṃs tataḥ prāñjalir abravīt । samudraṃ laṅghayitvāhaṃ śatayojanam āyatam ॥9॥
agacchaṃ jānakīṃ sītāṃ mārgamāṇo didṛkṣayā । tatra laṅketi nagarī rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ॥10॥
dakṣiṇasya samudrasya tīre vasati dakṣiṇe । tatra sītā mayā dṛṣṭā rāvaṇāntaḥpure satī ॥11॥
tvayi saṃnyasya jīvantī rāmā rāma manoratham । dṛṣṭā me rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhur muhuḥ ॥12॥
rākṣasībhir virūpābhī rakṣitā pramadāvane । duḥkham āpadyate tvayā vīra suḥkhocitā ॥13॥
rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā । ekaveṇīdharā dīnā tvayi cintāparāyaṇā ॥14॥
adhaḥśayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himāgame । rāvaṇād vinivṛttārthā martavyakṛtaniścayā ॥15॥
devī kathaṃ cit kākutstha tvanmanā mārgitā mayā । ikṣvākuvaṃśavikhyātiṃ śanaiḥ kīrtayatānagha ॥16॥
sā mayā naraśārdūla śanair viśvāsitā tadā । tataḥ sambhāṣitā devī sarvam arthaṃ ca darśitā ॥17॥
rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca śrutvā harṣam upāgatā । niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktiś cāsyāḥ sadā tvayi ॥18॥
evaṃ mayā mahābhāga dṛṣṭā janakanandinī । ugreṇa tapasā yuktā tvadbhaktyā puruṣarṣabha ॥19॥
punar apy āgatas tatra tvatsakāśam āriṃdama । tvaṃ taṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam ॥15॥
vadhārham api kākutstha kṛpayā paripālayaḥ । mogham astraṃ na śakyaṃ tu kartum ity eva rāghava ॥16॥
bhavāṃs tasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam । rāma tvāṃ sa namaskṛtya rājño daśarathasya ca ॥17॥
visṛṣṭas tu tadā kākaḥ pratipede kham ālayam । evam astravidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sattvavāñ śīlavān api ॥18॥
kimartham astraṃ rakṣaḥsu na yojayasi rāghava । na dānavā na gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ ॥19॥
tava rāma raṇe śaktas tathā pratisamāsitum । tava vīryavataḥ kaccin mayi yady asti sambhramaḥ ॥20॥
kṣipraṃ suniśitair bāṇair hanyatāṃ yudhi rāvaṇaḥ । bhrātur ādeśam ājñāya lakṣmaṇo vā paraṃtapaḥ ॥21॥
sa kimarthaṃ naravaro na māṃ rakṣati rāghavaḥ । śaktau tau puruṣavyāghrau vāyvagnisamatejasau ॥22॥
surāṇām api durdharṣau kimarthaṃ mām upekṣataḥ । mamaiva duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃ cin mahad asti na saṃśayaḥ ॥23॥
samarthau sahitau yan māṃ na rakṣete paraṃtapau । vaidehyā vacanaṃ śrutvā karuṇaṃ sāśrubhāṣitam ॥24॥
punar apy aham āryāṃ tām idaṃ vacanam abruvam । tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena te śape ॥25॥
rāme duḥkhābhibhūte ca lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate । kathaṃ cid bhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ pariśocitum ॥26॥
asmin muhūrte duḥkhānām antaṃ drakṣyasi bhāmini । tāv ubhau naraśārdūlau rājaputrāv paraṃtapau ॥27॥
tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhau laṅkāṃ bhasmīkariṣyataḥ । hatvā ca samare raudraṃ rāvaṇaṃ saha bāndhavam ॥28॥
rāghavas tvāṃ varārohe svapurīṃ nayitā dhruvam । yat tu rāmo vijānīyād abhijñānam anindite ॥29॥
prītisaṃjananaṃ tasya pradātuṃ tat tvam arhasi । sābhivīkṣya diśaḥ sarvā veṇyudgrathanam uttamam ॥30॥
muktvā vastrād dadau mahyaṃ maṇim etaṃ mahābala । pratigṛhya maṇiṃ dorbhyāṃ tava heto raghupriya ॥31॥
śirasā sampraṇamyainām aham āgamane tvare । gamane ca kṛtotsāham avekṣya varavarṇinī ॥32॥
vivardhamānaṃ ca hi mām uvāca janakātmajā । aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpagadgadabhāṣiṇī ॥33॥
mamotpatanasambhrāntā śokavegasamāhatā । mām uvāca tataḥ sītā sabhāgyo’si mahākape ॥34॥
yad drakṣyasi mahābāhuṃ rāmaṃ kamalalocanaṃ । lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābahuṃ devaraṃ me yaśasvinam ॥35॥
sītayāpy evam ukto ‘ham abruvaṃ maithilīṃ tathā । pṛṣṭham aroha me devi kṣipraṃ janakanandini ॥36॥
yavāt te darśayāmy adya sasugrīvaṃ salakṣmaṇam । rāghavaṃ ca mahābhage bhartāram asitekṣane ॥37॥
sābravīn māṃ tato devī naiṣa dharmo mahākape । yat te pṛṣṭhaṃ siṣeve ‘haṃ svavaśā haripuṃgava ॥38॥
purā ca yad ahaṃ vīra spṛṣṭā gātreṣu rakṣasā । tatrāhaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi kālenopanipīḍitā ॥39॥
gaccha tvaṃ kapiśardūla yatra tau nṛpateḥ sutau । ityevaṃ sā samābhāṣya bhūyaḥ saṃdeṣṭam āsthitā ॥40॥
